jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager - DevOps
jobs.description:
**Career-defining. Life-changing.**

At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

**About This Role:**

iRhythm is currently seeking an experienced Senior Technical Project Manager within the Research & Development team. You will have the opportunity to drive the delivery of medical device projects to domestic and international markets. You will be exposed to a diverse set of projects involving development and testing in the context of addressing unmet clinical needs. In addition, you will build a deep understanding of our end-to-end systems, helping to drive successful delivery of projects throughout the development life cycle.

Our work environment is fast-paced, with a collaborative atmosphere. Most of all, we are passionate about delivering innovations that improve the quality of health care and the patient experience. We are looking for like-minded individuals to join our team today!

The Technical Project Manager – DevOps leads complex initiatives that improve software delivery, cloud infrastructure, automation, reliability, and operational efficiency. This role partners closely with DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Software Engineering, Security, QA, IT, and Product teams to plan and execute technical initiatives from strategy through implementation.

The Technical Project Manager is responsible for driving delivery across multiple technical workstreams, managing dependencies and risks, establishing execution plans, and providing visibility to technical and executive stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**DevOps Program & Project Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex DevOps and cloud infrastructure initiatives.
* Develop project plans, milestones, schedules, dependencies, and execution strategies.
* Coordinate multiple engineering teams and technical workstreams to achieve delivery objectives.
* Drive execution against committed timelines and proactively address delivery risks.
* Facilitate technical planning, execution reviews, status meetings, and leadership escalations.

**CI/CD & Software Delivery**

* Partner with DevOps and engineering teams to improve CI/CD pipelines and software delivery processes.
* Coordinate initiatives involving build, integration, automated testing, deployment, and release automation.
* Track implementation of deployment strategies, environment management, and automated release processes.
* Identify bottlenecks in the software delivery lifecycle and coordinate improvement initiatives.
* Support adoption of standardized development and deployment practices across engineering teams.

**Cloud & Infrastructure Delivery**

* Coordinate projects involving cloud infrastructure, platforms, environments, networking, compute, storage, and supporting services.
* Partner with cloud and infrastructure engineers to manage technical dependencies and implementation plans.
* Coordinate cloud migrations, infrastructure modernization, platform upgrades, and environment improvements.
* Track infrastructure readiness and dependencies required to support application releases.

**Automation & Platform Engineering**

* Lead initiatives to improve infrastructure and deployment automation.
* Coordinate adoption of Infrastructure as Code and configuration-management practices.
* Support implementation of standardized DevOps tooling and engineering platforms.
* Drive initiatives that improve scalability, reliability, deployment frequency, and operational efficiency.

**Security & Compliance**

* Coordinate DevSecOps initiatives with Security, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams.
* Ensure security requirements and controls are incorporated into technical delivery plans.
* Track vulnerability remediation, security dependencies, and required technical approvals.
* Coordinate security testing and compliance activities associated with DevOps initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Technical Leadership**

* Serve as the primary project-management interface between DevOps and partner organizations.
* Coordinate across Software Engineering, Firmware, QA, Security, Product, IT, Operations, and Architecture teams.
* Manage technical dependencies and ensure teams understand ownership and delivery commitments.
* Facilitate technical decisions and escalate issues requiring leadership intervention.
* Translate complex technical information into clear project status and executive-level communication.

**Risk, Issue & Dependency Management**

* Maintain integrated project risk, issue, action, and dependency tracking.
* Identify technical and operational risks early and develop mitigation strategies.
* Manage cross-team dependencies that could affect delivery schedules.
* Drive resolution of blockers and escalate critical issues appropriately.

**Metrics & Executive Reporting**

* Develop project dashboards and executive reporting for DevOps initiatives.
* Track milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, delivery performance, and technical readiness.
* Establish metrics for delivery predictability, deployment performance, automation, and operational improvements.
* Provide leadership with clear visibility into project health and areas requiring intervention.

* Facilitate retrospectives and post-implementation reviews.
* Identify opportunities to improve engineering and DevOps processes.

16. Problem-Solving Skills:

17. Leadership and Decision-Making:

Infrastructure project support includes the assessment, maintenance, documentation, modernization, testing, and implementation / deployment for both software and hardware products.

The project manager is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, implementation, execution, and completion of projects ensuring consistency with organizational strategy, contractual commitments, and goals.

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

**Why Join Us**

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Senior Technical Project Manager (Compliance & Certifications) to coordinate, manage, and drive our technical compliance, security, and industry certification initiatives. In this role, you will be the operational engine behind our compliance roadmap—managing the rigid timelines of external audits while aligning execution across internal software development, IT/TechOps, and business operations cycles.

As a key member of our execution team, you will ensure that all compliance projects are structured, tracked, and reported in strict accordance with our corporate PMO Standards.

You will directly own and manage the planning, tracking, and execution of our annual Media Rating Council (MRC) accreditation and SOC2 (Type 1 and Type 2) audits. This role provides the critical project management, compliance oversight, governance, and auditability necessary to keep all teams aligned and audit-ready.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. PMO Reporting & Project Standards**

* **PMO Standards Alignment:** Manage and structure all compliance, security, and certification project plans, trackers, and document repositories in accordance with established PMO methodologies and guidelines.
* **Standardized Status Reporting:** Provide routine, structured progress reports, KPI dashboards, and project health updates (covering milestones, risks, and blockers) as defined by PMO reporting frameworks.
* **Risk & Issue Escalation:** Actively track dependencies and risks, executing formal escalation paths per PMO standards when compliance milestones are in jeopardy.
* **Platform Management:** Maintain up-to-date program trackers, schedules, and resource planning artifacts within central PMO tools (such as Asana or Jira) to ensure a single source of truth.

**2. Hybrid Project Management & Governance**

* **Milestone & Critical Path Tracking:** Establish clear, phase-gate project plans for upcoming audits, mapping out the critical path for audit readiness, dry-runs, evidence lock-down, and formal evaluation windows.
* **Requirements Translation:** Translate complex, rigid compliance controls (e.g., security protocols, data-filtering standards) into clear, actionable technical specifications, user stories, and development tasks.
* **Engineering Alignment:** Partner with Security, TechOps, Data, and Engineering teams to slot compliance-related tasks and vulnerability remediations into active development cycles (sprints or Kanban) without disrupting the core product roadmap.
* **Cross-Functional Compliance Oversight:** Oversee key operational controls managed by technical partner teams to ensure continuous audit readiness.

**3. Audit Coordination & Evidence Gathering**

* **Audit Liaison:** Serve as the primary operational contact and liaison for external auditors and assessors (e.g., MRC, EY, SOC2 auditors), ensuring meetings, requests, and inquiries are managed efficiently.
* **Evidence Management:** Project manage the continuous gathering, formatting, and submission of technical evidence (configurations, access logs, architectural diagrams) required for SOC2 and MRC evaluations.
* **Remediation Tracking:** Monitor and drive the resolution of any compliance gaps, audit findings, or vulnerability remediation tasks identified during pre-audits or continuous monitoring.

**4. Media Rating Council (MRC) Certification Support**

* **Audit Lifecycle Management:** Project manage the end-to-end timeline for annual MRC audits, pre-assessment phases, and ongoing compliance reviews.
* **Adtech & Measurement Standards:** Coordinate engineering and product tasks related to data pipelines, measurement methodologies, and filtration logic to ensure strict alignment with MRC and industry measurement standards.
* **Disclosure & Change Governance:** Coordinate the preparation, maintenance, and regular updating of methodology disclosures, and establish a **"Journal of Change"** process to manage and communicate changes to accredited elements with MRC and auditor representatives.
* **Business Operations Alignment:** Project manage compliance workflows across business operations required by MRC standards, including Business Partner Qualification (BPQ/client vetting), client onboarding/support disclosures, and discrepancy/data reissuance tracking.

**5. SOC2 Type 1 & Type 2 Support**

* **Audit Execution:** Organize the schedule, operational execution, and readiness milestones for annual SOC2 Type 1 and Type 2 audits.
* **Controls Integration:** Partner with engineering and IT teams to ensure system monitoring, access control reviews, and infrastructure configurations are consistently maintained and documented according to SOC2 Trust Services Criteria.
* **Automation Management:** Help manage and monitor compliance automation tooling (e.g., Vanta, Drata) to ensure continuous control verification and evidence tracking.

**PROJECT MANAGER - GRANT-FUNDED INITIATIVES (PART-TIME REMOTE)**

**OLIVE-HARVEY COLLEGE**

Reporting to the Executive Director-Strategic Initiatives, the Project Manager-Grant Funded Initiatives (PT Exempt Remote) provides leadership and oversight for the day-to-day execution of a multi-year grant-funded initiative at the college. This position is responsible for managing project scope, schedule, budget, deliverables, and outcomes to ensure alignment with institutional priorities and grant objectives.

The Project Manager exercises independent judgment and initiative in managing project operations, including setting priorities, allocating resources, making operational decisions, mitigating risk, and resolving issues to ensure successful achievement of project objectives and compliance with institutional and funding requirements.

This is a fully remote position and is grant funded through September 30, 2028. All duties and responsibilities are expected to be performed virtually.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

* Direct and manage a complex, multi-year grant-funded initiative, providing overall leadership and accountability for managing project scope, schedule, budget, deliverables, and outcomes to ensure alignment with institutional priorities and grant objectives.
* Lead all phases of the project lifecycle, including project charter development, strategic planning, implementation, performance monitoring, risk mitigation, issue resolution, change management, and project closeout.
* Establish effective project governance structures, decision-making processes, and performance frameworks to ensure successful project execution, stakeholder engagement, and achievement of project goals.
* Develop and manage comprehensive project plans, timelines, workstreams, resource allocations, and performance measures, proactively identifying dependencies, constraints, and opportunities to optimize project performance.
* Serve as the primary liaison to executive leadership, grant sponsors, external partners, and cross-functional stakeholders, facilitating collaboration, influencing decision-making and ensuring alignment on project priorities and deliverables.
* Monitor project budgets, expenditures, and resource utilization to ensure compliance with grant requirements, institutional policies, and funding expectations.
* Establish and evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs), success metrics, and project outcome measures to assess effectiveness, support strategic decision-making, and demonstrate project impact.
* Lead cross-functional teams by assigning responsibilities, monitoring progress, facilitating collaboration, and promoting accountability for project deliverables.
* Prepare and present executive-level reports, recommendations, and project status updates to senior leadership, funding agencies, and other key stakeholders.
* Analyze project outcomes and organizational impact, recommending process improvements, sustainability strategies, and opportunities to expand or replicate successful practices.
* Utilize project management methodologies, tools, and best practices to ensure efficient project execution, stakeholder engagement, and operational effectiveness in a fully remote environment.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, customer service excellence, accountability, and collaboration while maintaining professionalism, confidentiality, and adherence to City Colleges of Chicago policies and standards.
* Perform related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelors degree from an accredited college or university required
* Minimum of three (3) years of progressively responsible professional experience required, preferably in project management, program management, grant administration, or a related field.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered at the discretion of management.
* Employees working remotely are responsible for providing a stable internet environment with a connection speed of at least 300 megabytes per second (Mbps).
* Demonstrated knowledge and experience managing grant-funded projects or complex initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, preferably within a higher education, government, or other complex organization.
* Knowledge of project management principles, methodologies, and tools required.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare reports, presentations and other communications for diverse audiences.
* Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing project needs.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in a fully remote work environment.
* Demonstrated commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and student success.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams).

Salary: $32,500 annually

Offered salary will be determined by the applicant's education, knowledge, skills and abilities, as well as other factors such as internal equity.

jobs.title: PROJECT MANAGER - M&A Integration & De Novo Pharmacy Builds
jobs.description:
**It’s not just a job. It’s a mission.**

Altruix is a high-touch pharmacy dedicated to serving behavioral health and intellectual and developmental disability populations. Through our pharmacy expertise, and specialized packaging, we promote medication adherence and improve patient outcomes. Our services help clients take medications as prescribed while reducing administrative burden for providers. Altruix customers achieve measurable results, including 90% adherence rates and a 40% reduction in ER and hospital-related costs. Learn more at www.altruix.com.

Altruix is seeking a hands-on **Project Manager - M&A Integration & De Novo Pharmacy Builds** to lead the execution of pharmacy acquisitions, integrations, De Novo builds, and relocations. This role translates approved growth opportunities into actionable project plans and drives execution from pre-close or initial planning through launch, stabilization, and transition to ongoing operations. The Project Manager coordinates cross-functional teams, maintains accountability for milestones and deliverables, identifies and escalates risks, and supports multiple concurrent projects while strengthening Altruix’s repeatable M&A and De Novo implementation processes.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own integrated project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and deliverables, ensuring clear ownership and accountability across workstreams
* Lead project kickoffs, workstream reviews, and readiness meetings; document decisions and drive timely resolution of action items, risks, and dependencies
* Maintain project dashboards, risk and issue tracking, and leadership reporting, clearly communicating status, decisions needed, and recovery plans
* Coordinate cross-functional work across Operations, Clinical and Quality, Legal and Compliance, Finance, HR, IT, Revenue Cycle, Payer, Licensing, Facilities, Procurement, Sales, Marketing, 340B, and Logistics

  

**De Novo Builds and Pharmacy Relocations:**

* Translate approved opportunities into project scope, budgets, launch plans, timelines, and readiness requirements, escalating material changes to cost, timing, staffing, or scope
* Coordinate site selection, lease and facility activities, permitting, construction, licensing, equipment, technology, staffing, supplier setup, inventory, and operational readiness with functional owners and external partners
* Manage pharmacy relocations and De Novo launches, ensuring licensing, payer, staffing, technology, patient transition, and operational dependencies are addressed before opening

  

**M&A Integration:**

* Build and manage transaction-specific integration plans based on deal structure, locations, licensing, payer enrollment, workforce, systems, contracts, and operational requirements
* Coordinate seller information requests and pre-close planning in accordance with Legal-approved access and confidentiality requirements
* Drive Day 1 readiness and post-close integration through stabilization, coordinating employee onboarding, financial and billing continuity, procurement, technology, supplier transitions, communications, and operating workflows
* Coordinate system migrations, testing, cutover, contingency planning, and operational support to minimize disruption to patient and client service

  

**Launch Readiness and Continuous Improvement:**

* Coordinate functional readiness signoffs and escalate unresolved regulatory, patient-safety, payer, security, financial, or operational risks before launch
* Lead launch support, issue resolution, stabilization reviews, and formal handoff to ongoing Operations
* Monitor project performance against approved scope, schedule, budget, and operating objectives; capture lessons learned and continuously improve implementation playbooks and templates

  

**Success Metrics:**

* Success is demonstrated through reliable milestone delivery, clear cross-functional accountability, controlled scope and budget, launch readiness, continuity of patient and client service, effective issue resolution, and successful transition to ongoing operations

  

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare administration, project management, or related field, or equivalent relevant experience
* 5+ years of project management or implementation experience leading complex, cross-functional projects involving multiple departments, vendors, or locations
* Experience in healthcare, pharmacy operations, acquisitions/integrations, facility openings, or other regulated environments strongly preferred
* Strong planning, facilitation, communication, problem-solving, and follow-through skills with the ability to influence across functional teams
* Proficiency with Excel and project management tools, including schedules, dashboards, budgets, and action tracking

* PMP or equivalent certification preferred
* Behavioral health or long-term care pharmacy, pharmacy system conversions, construction coordination, and/or 340B experience preferred

  

**Travel Expectations:**

* Travel is required for site assessments, acquisition transitions, construction milestones, and pharmacy launches. Occasional work outside normal business hours may be required during critical transitions

  

**BENEFITS:**

* Salary of $115,000 to $125,000 based on experience
* Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, and Long-Term Disability
* 401(k) program
* Paid time off
* Paid holidays

  

**EEOC:**

Altruix is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, placement, training, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation, or other employment practices based on any protected characteristic under federal, state, or local law. Altruix is a drug-free workplace and requires pre-employment drug and alcohol testing as a condition of employment.

**Agile Project Manager I**

**DCHIPS Team – Senior Health Agile Release Train**
---------------------------------------------------

We are seeking an Agile Project Manager I to join the DCHIPS team within our Senior Health Agile Release Train (ART). This role is ideal for a highly organized Project Manager who enjoys keeping teams aligned, keeping work visible, and moving delivery forward in a collaborative Agile environment.

DCHIPS is a team of approximately 14 engineers, support specialists, and data specialists supporting two core enterprise data systems – DCH (Data Clearinghouse) and CPIS (Client Policy Information System), including its mainframe and web components – along with UDB and customer-facing APIs. The team balances ongoing production support with project and enhancement delivery and is working to automate and streamline day-to-day support so it can focus on modernizing these platforms. The team is distributed across multiple states.

As the team's Agile Project Manager, you will own daily support ticket intake and work management, project status reporting, and Agile planning, along with stakeholder communication and incident visibility. No two days are exactly alike.

Over the next 6–12 months, you will help strengthen DCHIPS operational maturity, enhance project and portfolio status reporting by moving it from spreadsheets and slides into Jira Roadmaps, improve and further automate intake and work management processes, establish incident-management tracking, and support Medicare and Senior Health initiatives.

Unlike many traditional PM roles, this position offers exposure to Agile delivery, incident management, service management, and leadership communication, with visibility across Senior Health and Information Services. You will be supported by structured onboarding, hands-on training, documented team processes, access to the team's previous Agile Project Manager for knowledge transfer, and ongoing coaching as you ramp up.

If you are proactive, dependable, and energized by bringing clarity to complex work, we encourage you to apply.

**WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:**

* Estimated Salary: Project Manager I: $100k - $120k, plus annual bonus.
* 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
* Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.
* Primarily remote, with periodic onsite collaboration for quarterly 2-day PI (Program Increment) planning events, plus occasional 2-day team-building sessions.
* **Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.**

***This role is classified as remote; however, periodic in-person attendance will be required at times for activities such as quarterly or project planning, training, or other business-critical meetings***

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* Lead daily support ticket intake triage across multiple Jira work queues and partner with Product Owners and technical leads to rout, prioritize, and coordinate incoming request.
* Coordinate and follow up on action items, decisions, risks, and dependencies across technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership.
* Maintain and improve intake automation and workflow rules to reduce manual triage.
* Support sprint planning, sprint changeover, and PI planning preparation and follow-up, including reporting PI risks and status at the ART level.
* Facilitate capacity planning by balancing project delivery commitments, recurring support responsibilities, PTO, and carryover work to support realistic sprint commitments.
* Coordinate on-call support rotations, support assignments, and support-story creation.
* Maintain Jira data quality, hierarchy, reporting structures, and planning standards.
* Track project and initiative status, maintain visibility into active initiatives, milestones, projected completion dates, dependencies, and delivery health across the DCHIPS portfolio using Jira Roadmaps.
* Support incident tracking, communications, escalations, root-cause follow-up activities, and operational reporting to improve visibility into productions support trends.
* Deliver clear, timely status updates to leadership and stakeholders across technical and business teams.
* Partner with Product Owners, engineers, architects, support leads, and ART leadership to keep work visible and appropriately prioritized.
* Drive continuous improvement across planning, intake, support operations, reporting, and process automation.
* Occasionally provide after-hours support for release approvals, weekend validation, or major-incident coordination.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

* Experience in Agile Project Management or coordinating work for software, IT, or technical teams.
* Familiarity with Agile principles and practices.

**About Brightway**

Established in 2008, Brightway is proud to be one of the fastest-growing insurance agency systems in the United States. With over 350 franchises spanning 35+ states and an impressive $1.3 billion in annual premiums, we rank among the nation’s largest privately owned property and casualty insurance distribution companies. We support our agency owners with comprehensive back-office services, marketing resources, and continuous learning and development.

We are embarking on the next stage of our customer-centric growth, driven by innovation from our talented associates and the application of cutting-edge technologies. This growth has opened doors for creative thinkers who thrive in a diverse and collaborative culture. As a Brightway team member, you'll engage in exciting projects that are reshaping the industry, working alongside a dedicated team committed to delivering exceptional customer service and safeguarding our clients' most valuable assets.

-

**Scope**

Brightway is seeking an Agency Acquisitions Project Manager to own end-to-end project management for agency and book acquisitions from Letter of Intent (LOI) through close. As the operational backbone of Brightway’s M&A program, this role ensures every acquisition—whether a franchise conversion or a jointly structured book purchase—moves efficiently from signed LOI to a fully integrated, closed deal.

This role sits at the intersection of operations, carrier relations, and cross-functional coordination. The ideal candidate is a highly organized, detail-oriented project manager who can manage multiple concurrent deals, hold internal and external partners accountable to deadlines, and keep closings on track. This position offers regular visibility to Brightway’s leadership team and the opportunity to help scale a critical growth function.

The primary objective of this role is to accelerate deal closings and reduce the time from LOI to close by managing the full lifecycle of each acquisition with rigor, urgency, and clear communication.

**Role Overview**

The Agency Acquisitions Project Manager leads each acquisition through the post-LOI process. Brightway’s M&A program includes two primary deal types:

* Franchise Conversions — Brightway acquires an independent agent’s book of business, and the agent converts their existing agency into a Brightway franchise.
* Book Acquisitions — Brightway jointly purchases a book of business with an existing Brightway franchisee.

Across both deal types, this role coordinates due diligence, gathers policy-level and carrier information, ensures data is organized and delivered to the QC team for entry into the agency management system, and drives all workstreams through closing.

**Job Responsibilities**

1. Deal Project Management

* Own the project plan, milestone timeline, and deal calendar for each active acquisition from LOI through close.

* Manage process checklists and keep all workstreams moving in parallel.
* Proactively identify risks, remove roadblocks, and escalate complex issues to the right stakeholders with a clear path to resolution.
* Act as the primary post-LOI point of contact for internal stakeholders, external partners, and acquisition participants.

2. Due Diligence Coordination

* Collect, organize, and track all due diligence materials required to evaluate, process, and close each deal.
* Follow up with agents, carriers, and internal teams to ensure materials are complete and received on time.
* Maintain organized, audit-ready documentation for each acquisition.

3. Carrier Coordination & Policy Data

* Partner with Brightway’s carrier team and, when needed, carriers directly to obtain policy lists and book-level information for each acquired book of business.
* Track carrier appointment transfers and code migrations required to bring new agents into Brightway’s systems.
* Learn and document carrier-specific processes for book transfers to ensure consistency and replicability across deals.

4. QC & System Integration

* Compile and present policy information to the QC team in the format required for entry into the agency management system.
* Monitor data completeness and accuracy; flag discrepancies and work with relevant parties to resolve.
* Ensure a seamless handoff to the QC and onboarding teams so each deal closes cleanly and transitions smoothly.

5. Agent Communication & Onboarding Support

* Serve as a key point of contact for incoming agents during the acquisition process, setting clear expectations and providing timely updates.
* Conduct orientation calls with new agents as needed to explain the appointment and migration process.
* Manage inbound requests from internal and external partners and follow up on action items appropriately.

**Skills, Licenses, Certifications**

* Strong project management skills, including the ability to build and manage timelines, own deliverables, and drive work to completion across multiple concurrent deals.
* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy in a high-stakes environment.
* Strong communicator able to convey information clearly and concisely to agents, carriers, and senior leadership.
* Proactive, service-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership and follow-through.
* Ability to understand and navigate insurance carrier processes and operations.
* Strong independent judgment and sound decision-making under time pressure.
* Excellent time management skills, with the ability to prioritize across a portfolio of active deals and manage competing demands.
* Team player who can both contribute independently and rely on cross-functional colleagues to move deals forward.
* Demonstrates Brightway values of Smart, Accountable, and Trustworthy.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint); experience with CRM, workflow, or project management tools is a plus.

The ideal candidate combines strong project management rigor with a deep understanding of data center automation, controls, and energy systems to ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget, and in strict alignment with owner standards and operational requirements.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to senior client and executive stakeholders.

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Direct experience with hyperscale data center clients or operators.
* Familiarity with leading BMS and automation platforms used in data centers (e.g., Siemens, Schneider Electric, Honeywell, Johnson Controls).
* Experience supporting commissioning and integrated systems testing (IST) for mission-critical facilities.
* Experience with Design-Build or fast-track delivery models.
* LEED AP or other sustainability-related certifications.

Turn P&C product decisions into build-ready requirements, then confirm they shipped right. Forms, rating, state launches? Yes. 5+ years BA, 3+ in P&C required.

**Who we are**
--------------

Kin makes life simpler, more affordable, and better for homeowners — especially in the places where climate risks, rising costs, and outdated systems make it harder. We start with smarter homeowners insurance and expand to everything homeowners need to thrive.

Using data, technology, and thoughtful human support, we’re building products that are clear, fair, and help homeowners feel confident — so homeowners aren’t left behind when they need help most.

Founded in 2016, Kin is a remote-first employer with Kinfolk across more than 35 states. We serve customers in 14 states (and counting). Our disciplined growth, strong customer satisfaction, and focus on long-term sustainability fosters outstanding growth, attracts marquee investors, and earns recognition and accolades, including:

* Built In Chicago's Best Places to Work, Midsize Companies (2021-2026)
* Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers (2026)
* Inc. 5000 Fastest-Growing Private Companies
* Forbes’ Fintech 50 (2023-2026)
* Great Places to Work Certified (May 2024-May 2027)

Most importantly, we’re building Kin to be a place where people do meaningful work with real impact — for our customers, our communities, and each other. We're excited to tell you more about how you can contribute to our rapid growth, strong unit economics, profitability, and excellent customer ratings. To learn more about how we work and what we’re building, visit kin.com and see how we work.

**The opportunity**
-------------------

We're looking for a Senior Insurance Business Analyst to help us turn insurance product decisions into systems that work exactly as intended. Kin keeps entering new states and expanding its products. Each launch, filing, and coverage change depends on clear translation between the people who design insurance products and the engineers who build them. This role sits at that intersection of insurance product development, operations, and technical delivery. It's built for someone who knows P&C insurance products deeply and asks the right questions early.

You'll sit within the Project Management Organization and own the requirements lifecycle for new products, state launches, endorsements, coverage changes, forms, rating updates, and compliance requirements. You'll work across Insurance Product, Actuarial, Underwriting, Compliance, Claims, Operations, Engineering, and Tech Product to define what needs to be built and confirm it was built correctly. As your ownership grows, you'll become the go-to resource for teams that depend on accurate, implementation-ready requirements. Your work will directly shape how quickly and reliably Kin brings products to homeowners.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Own the requirements lifecycle for insurance product and state-configuration changes, from initial discovery through an implementation-ready handoff to Engineering and Tech Product
* Translate business decisions on new products, insurance filings, forms, endorsements, coverages, rating algorithms, eligibility rules, and state-specific configurations into clear business requirements and functional specifications
* Partner with Insurance Product, Actuarial, Underwriting, Compliance, Claims, Operations, Tech Product, and Engineering to gather inputs, resolve ambiguity, confirm decisions, and maintain alignment from business decision through system deployment
* Document current-state processes and system behavior, define future-state workflows, and manage requirements changes throughout delivery
* Identify gaps, edge cases, dependencies, compliance requirements, and downstream impacts across rating, policy administration, billing, claims, servicing, and reporting before development begins
* Assess the customer, operational, and system impact of proposed product rules, and recommend alternative approaches when a requirement would create unnecessary friction, cost, or unintended consequences

**Job Title**

Net Zero Program Manager Lead

**Job Description Summary**

The Net Zero Program Manager Lead combines Net Zero subject-matter leadership with day-to-day program management of the client’s decarbonization portfolio. The role shapes the roadmap, guides technical and investment priorities, and converts strategy into an executable pipeline of projects.

**Job Description**

Working with Account Executives, client leaders, project teams, and Sustainability specialists, this position maintains control of scope, schedule, budget, risk, dependencies, decisions, and performance. The successful candidate brings credible sustainability and building-decarbonization expertise together with the project-delivery discipline to move initiatives from concept through implementation and verified results.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program Delivery and Governance**

* Lead day-to-day management of a portfolio of Net Zero and decarbonization projects across multiple sites and workstreams.

* Translate program objectives into defined scopes, work plans, milestones, ownership, and measurable outcomes.

* Maintain the integrated program roadmap, master schedule, governance calendar, and project pipeline.

* Establish meeting cadences, decision rights, escalation paths, and accountability across internal teams and service partners.

* Drive action-item closure, resolve cross-project dependencies, and escalate decisions that require executive direction.

**Schedule Cost Risk and Change Management**

* Manage schedule baselines, critical-path activities, milestones, resource constraints, and recovery plans across the portfolio.

* Maintain program-level visibility into approved budgets, commitments, actuals, forecasts, variances, and future funding needs.

* Partner with finance, procurement, and project teams to reconcile cost information and support annual and multi-year capital planning.

* Maintain risk, issue, assumption, dependency, decision, and change logs with clear owners, due dates, and mitigation actions.

* Apply change control to material changes in scope, schedule, budget, or expected outcomes and elevate variances with recommended corrective actions.

**Reporting and Performance Management**

* Produce standardized weekly and monthly reporting on schedule, cost, milestones, risks, decisions, and program performance.

* Develop executive dashboards and governance materials that convert detailed project information into concise, actionable insights.

* Define and maintain program KPIs for project delivery, capital deployment, energy, emissions, savings, and other agreed outcomes.

* Coordinate source-data collection and validation across project, sustainability, engineering, finance, and data teams.

**Net Zero Strategy and Project Execution**

* Serve as a Net Zero subject-matter lead for Account Executives and client stakeholders, advising on decarbonization pathways, building systems, electrification, energy efficiency, renewable energy, and emissions-reduction priorities.

* Own and maintain the portfolio decarbonization roadmap, including asset-level opportunities, equipment-replacement strategies, capital requirements, implementation timing, and expected energy and carbon outcomes.

* Establish evaluation and prioritization criteria that balance carbon impact, financial performance, operational needs, asset strategy, regulatory requirements, and delivery readiness.

* Guide initiatives from opportunity identification through feasibility, business case, approval, design, procurement, implementation, commissioning, measurement and verification, and closeout.

* Partner with engineering and technical specialists to validate assumptions and ensure projects meet agreed scope, schedule, budget, quality, and performance requirements.

**Stakeholder and Vendor Coordination**

* Coordinate client stakeholders, C&W account teams, project managers, engineering, sustainability, facilities, procurement, finance, utilities, landlords, consultants, and contractors.

* Facilitate governance meetings, working sessions, budget reviews, and executive updates; document decisions and required actions.

* Support scopes of work, RFPs, vendor evaluations, contracting, and supplier performance management as required.

* Hold internal and external teams accountable for agreed deliverables and communicate effectively with both technical and executive audiences.



**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction or project management, sustainability, business, real estate, or a related discipline.

* Seven or more years of progressively responsible experience spanning program or project management and Net Zero, energy, sustainability, engineering, or building decarbonization.

* Demonstrated command of scope, schedule, budget, forecasting, risk, change control, governance, and executive reporting.

* Demonstrated ability to develop decarbonization roadmaps, evaluate energy and carbon opportunities, and translate technical strategy into executable projects.

* Experience developing integrated schedules, budgets, milestone plans, dashboards, and decision-ready reporting.

* Ability to lead cross-functional teams in a matrixed organization and influence outcomes without direct authority.

* Strong analytical, communication, facilitation, and client-service skills, including experience presenting to senior leaders.

* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint and experience with enterprise project, program, or reporting platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering Net Zero, energy-efficiency, electrification, renewable-energy, building-performance, MEP, or capital-improvement programs across a large commercial real estate portfolio.

* Experience developing business cases and evaluating projects using financial, operational, energy, and carbon criteria.

* Experience in financial services, corporate real estate, or another large global enterprise environ

Universal Technical Resource Services, Inc. (UTRS) is currently seeking an Operations Analyst to join our team! At UTRS, we enjoy the benefits of working in a collaborative environment of close-knit team members. As a company, we provide a wide range of leading-edge engineering, management, and digital services to the public and private sectors. We are looking for someone that will support our mission to consistently deliver creative, high-quality, technology-based services to our customers on time and within budget.

  

This position will be a key member of the Weapon Systems & Technology Directorate supporting government projects at Picatinny Arsenal, NJ.

**What will you be doing?**

  

* Consulting and Document Review: Conduct technical reviews of draft Performance Work Statements and Statement of Objectives for materials contracts. Evaluate external whitepaper submissions for technical feasibility, innovation, and alignment with mission’s goals. Provide objective, expert recommendations to the government task manager regarding technical proposals.
* Work Package Planning and Preparation: Draft detailed project work packages, work breakdown structures and resource estimates. Formulate technical execution schedules and sequencing plans. Prepare necessary technical documents, checklists, and safety plans for package release.
* Coordination and Integration. Coordinate across multi-disciplinary teams to align work packages with broader programming milestones. Facilitate technical planning meetings, take actions items, and track dependencies. Serve as the technical liaison between working-level teams and government leadership.
* Documentation and Reporting: Maintain a meticulous record of project plans, change requests, and review outputs. Author comprehensive technical reports, briefing slides, and program summaries. Track performance metrics and prepare monthly progress reports.

  

**What skills will the ideal candidate have to be successful?**

  

* Must be US Citizen with a valid driver’s license
* Must be able to obtain a DoD Common Access Card

* Must be able to pass drug and alcohol testing
* Must have a bachelor’s degree in a related field (or equivalent years of experience) and 10+ years of experience

* Proficient in MS Word, Excel and Outlook at a minimum
* Excellent communication skills and writing skills
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and draw meaningful conclusions
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently
* Self-motivated with the ability to work well within a team
* Government or contractor experience a plus

  

Read about our benefits here: Our Benefits - UTRS | Always, Got Your Back

UTRS is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.description:
**Corporate Secretary Operations & Technology Analyst**

**About the Role**

As a member of the Service Delivery team within the Global Legal, Compliance & Regulatory organization, you will support AIG's global corporate governance and entity management activities. This role serves as a key partner to Corporate Secretary, Legal, and business stakeholders, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of corporate records, supporting governance processes, and managing entity lifecycle events across a complex global organization.

The role also acts as the primary administrator for AIG's entity management platform, leveraging technology and data to enable efficient governance, reporting, and compliance activities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Corporate Governance & Entity Management**

* Support global entity management activities, including entity formation, dissolution, restructuring, officer and director changes, and other lifecycle events.
* Maintain accurate corporate records and entity information to support governance and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Partner with Corporate Secretary, Legal, and executive stakeholders to support governance-related activities and special projects.
* Assist with board and committee governance processes, including document management and meeting support.
* Monitor and maintain compliance with corporate governance policies and entity reporting requirements.
* Serve as a subject matter resource on entity management processes and best practices.

**Systems Administration & Reporting**

* Act as primary administrator for AIG's entity management platform, ensuring data integrity, quality, and system functionality.
* Manage production, quality assurance, and delivery of governance and entity management reporting.
* Analyze entity data, identify inconsistencies, and implement sustainable solutions to improve data quality.
* Partner with technology teams and business stakeholders to identify and implement process improvements and system enhancements.
* Lead user acceptance testing, platform upgrades, maintenance releases, and reporting enhancements.
* Maintain technical and process documentation and provide support for user inquiries and system-related issues.
* Support board management technology platforms in partnership with technology teams and governance stakeholders.

**Qualifications:**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* Experience supporting corporate governance, corporate secretary, or entity management functions within a legal department, law firm, financial services organization, or other regulated environment.
* Experience managing corporate records, entity lifecycle events, and governance documentation.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to interact professionally with senior leaders and executive stakeholders.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience serving as an administrator for an entity management platform such as Diligent Entities, GEMS, Blueprint OneWorld, or similar systems.
* Paralegal certification or equivalent corporate governance/entity management experience.
* Experience supporting board governance and Corporate Secretary functions.
* Experience working within a global, highly regulated corporate environment.
* Advanced reporting and data analysis skills.

The base salary range is $81,000-$110,000 and the position is eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan. Your actual compensation will be dependent on your skills, experience, and qualifications. In addition, we’re proud to offer a range of competitive benefits, a summary of which can be viewed here: US Benefits

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

When you join Suburban Propane, you become a part of a fast-paced and dynamic company that has been serving its employees and customers for 97 years. As a **Financial/Operations Analyst** you will support the Financial Planning & Analysis department by developing accurate financial reports, business analyses, and executive-ready presentations that help leadership evaluate performance and make informed business decisions. This role applies financial concepts, reporting processes, and analytical judgment to assess the impact of operational and strategic initiatives across the Company. The position partners with stakeholders across departments, maintains key reporting tools and processes, and communicates complex information clearly, concisely, and professionally to all levels of management

jobs.title: Information Security Analyst
jobs.description:
Requisition ID:

**7443**

Katten is a full-service law firm with approximately 650 attorneys in locations across the United States and in London and Shanghai. Clients seeking sophisticated, high-value legal services turn to Katten for counsel locally, nationally and internationally. The firm’s core areas of practice include corporate, financial markets and funds, restructuring, intellectual property, litigation, real estate, structured finance and securitization, transactional tax planning, private credit and private wealth. Katten represents public and private companies in numerous industries, as well as a number of government and nonprofit organizations and individuals.

**Information Security Analyst**

Reporting to the Information Security Manager, the Information Security Analyst monitors, investigates, and responds to security events across the organization while helping improve threat detection, incident response, and data protection capabilities. The Analyst independently investigates security concerns, identifies emerging threats, and recommends practical enhancements to strengthen the Firm's security posture. Maintains professionalism and strict confidentiality in all client and Firm matters.

**The Information Security Analyst can be located in our Chicago, Charlotte, Dallas, New York, Los Angeles or Washington D.C. office.** Katten offers a hybrid work model, allowing the flexibility to work both on-site and remotely on a regular basis (KattenFlex).

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** include, but may not be limited to, the following. Other duties may be requested and/or assigned. Essential functions are primary job duties that an individual must be able to perform successfully with or without a reasonable accommodation. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Analyze security logs and correlate data from multiple sources to identify suspicious or anomalous activity.
* Conduct proactive threat hunting and identify indicators of compromise before they develop into larger incidents.
* Investigate DLP, endpoint, XDR/EDR, and Zscaler alerts, documenting findings and escalating issues as appropriate.
* Support incident response activities, including evidence collection, analysis, containment, remediation, and post-incident review.
* Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, application, and business stakeholders on investigations and risk mitigation efforts.
* Assist in developing and enhancing detection rules, alerts, monitoring processes, and security controls.
* Maintain awareness of emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and relevant attack techniques.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, and two (2) to four (4) years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, incident response, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Relevant certifications such as Security+, GCIH, or similar security certifications preferred.
* Experience investigating security alerts, suspicious activity, and potential security incidents.
* Experience with the following:

  + SIEM, XDR/EDR, endpoint security, DLP, network security, or similar technologies.
  + A ticketing or case-management platform such as ServiceNow.
  + Zscaler, Microsoft Defender, LogRhythm, Trend Micro Vision One, or comparable security platforms.
  + Working with an MSSP or Security Operations Center.
  + DLP investigations, data protection controls, and detection-rule development.
* Familiarity with threat-hunting methodologies and the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple investigations, and communicate technical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to communicate with courtesy and diplomacy and efficiently follow written and verbal instructions.
* Excellent organizational skills including record keeping, data collection, and system information. Ability to compile and analyze data and furnish information in report format, written correspondence, e mail, or verbally.
* Ability to identify and analyze complex issues and problems and to recommend and implement solutions.
* Work occasionally requires more than 35 hours per week to perform the essential duties of the position.
* Occasional travel to other Firm locations may be required.

In our New York office, the annualized salary range for this position is $95,000 to $110,000. Actual pay will be adjusted based on experience and other job-related factors permitted by law.

We offer an outstanding benefit package which includes: medical/dental/vision, 401k with employer contribution, parental leave, transportation fringe benefit program, back-up care option, generous paid time off policy and long-term and short-term disability policies.

Katten Muchin Rosenman LLP in an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.title: Business Analyst – Client Solutions
jobs.description:
Business Analyst – Client Solutions

We are seeking a motivated and business-minded **Business Analyst – Client Solutions** to join our team.

This is a **client-facing sales and business development position**. The primary responsibility is to identify and develop your own prospective business clients, understand the challenges they are facing, and determine whether our company can provide solutions to help improve their financial position, cash flow, financing structure, or overall business strategy.

**Important:** This is not a traditional back-office analyst position. The company does **not** provide a pre-existing list of client names, phone numbers, or guaranteed leads. Candidates must be comfortable prospecting, networking, making outbound calls, developing referral relationships, and building their own client pipeline.

Responsibilities

* Identify and prospect new small and mid-sized business clients
* Build and maintain your own pipeline through outbound calls, networking, referrals, and other business development activities
* Speak directly with business owners to understand their operations, financial challenges, and business goals
* Analyze each client's situation and identify the key problems affecting their business
* Review business needs such as cash flow, working capital, debt, expansion, equipment purchases, and other financial challenges
* Determine whether our company has a suitable solution for the client's needs
* Present appropriate financial and business solutions to prospective clients
* Follow up with prospects and guide qualified clients through the process
* Develop long-term relationships with business owners and referral partners
* Maintain accurate records of prospects, conversations, opportunities, and follow-ups in the company's CRM
* Work with management and operations teams to structure solutions for qualified clients
* Meet individual sales, prospecting, and business development goals

What We're Looking For

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Comfortable speaking with business owners and decision-makers
* Sales-oriented and motivated to develop new business
* Ability to prospect and find potential clients independently
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
* Ability to understand a business owner's challenges and recommend practical solutions
* Organized and comfortable managing multiple prospects and follow-ups
* Previous experience in sales, business development, financial services, consulting, banking, lending, or B2B services is preferred
* CRM experience is a plus

Who Will Succeed in This Role

This position is a strong fit for someone who enjoys **sales, problem-solving, and working directly with business owners**.

You should be comfortable starting conversations with new prospects, asking questions to understand how their business operates, identifying financial or operational challenges, and turning those conversations into business opportunities.

If you are looking for a traditional analyst position where clients and assignments are provided to you, this position may not be the right fit.

If you are entrepreneurial, comfortable developing your own relationships, and interested in helping businesses solve financial challenges, we would like to hear from you.

Job Types: Contract, Full-time

Pay: $53,014.00 - $118,188.00 per year

Benefits:

* Green card sponsorship
* Professional development assistance

* This is a client-facing sales and business development role. Are you comfortable prospecting and contacting new business owners to develop your own client pipeline?

Location Honolulu, Hawaii Category Logistics & Government Services Job Type Full time Job Id R2127156 Posted Date 10/06/2026

  

**Title:**

Principal Operations Research Analyst

At KBR, we deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 85 countries and operations in over 28 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results.

  
  

Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027. Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions. Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact.

  

Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

KBR is seeking a highly skilled and experienced **Principal Operations Research Analyst** with a strong background in combat modeling, simulation, and analysis (MS&A) to join a dynamic, forward-based team in Hawaii. In this role, you will collaborate with a high-performing, multidisciplinary team of planners, analysts, and technical experts leveraging advanced MS&A tools and techniques to shape and inform Concept Exploration, Course of Action Analysis, and Operational Planning efforts for U.S. Pacific Command (USPACOM), the Department of War (DoW), and other key stakeholders. This team operates in close coordination with a parent organization located in the National Capital Region (NCR). The ideal candidate shall:

* Lead or support the conduct of mission-level analytical studies for operational- and senior-level military decision makers, technology developers, and acquisition professionals for use in CONOPS development, force structure design, resource allocation, and targeted technology insertion.
* Design experiments, define metrics, and analyze simulation outputs to produce actionable insights.
* Conduct pre- and post-simulation analyses as needed.
* Collaborate directly with military operations subject matter experts, planners, and distributed teams to develop and refine trustworthy, scalable models, behaviors, and scenarios.
* Develop reusable model components and behaviors and maintain clear technical documentation.
* Produce high-impact deliverables (briefings, visualizations, reports) for senior DoW stakeholders.
* Work independently in a forward environment while coordinating with a reach-back team in the NCR.
  

  

**Work Environment:**

* **Location:** On-site in Hawaii, supporting a mission-critical USPACOM environment
* **Travel Requirements:** Minimal 0-20%, supporting strong work-life balance
* **Working Hours:** Standard
  

  

**Qualifications:**

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, or related STEM discipline with 10+ years of relevant experience
* Strong knowledge of simulation analysis and experiment design & analysis techniques
* High level of proficiency in R, MATLAB, Python, JupyterLab and/or Jupyter Notebook
* High level of proficiency in at least one mission-level combat modeling & simulation framework such as AFSIM, SAFE-SiM, or NGTS
* Demonstrated technical leadership or study lead experience
* Competent understanding of model-based systems engineering (MBSE) diagrams and techniques
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a small, high-performance team environment
* Strong collaborative skills with experience working in expert-driven, multidisciplinary teams

**Desired:**

* Master’s degree in Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, or related STEM discipline with 12+ years of relevant experience
* Expert level of proficiency in R, MATLAB, Python, JupyterLab and/or Jupyter Notebook
* Expert level of proficiency in at least one mission-level combat modeling & simulation frameworks such as AFSIM, SAFE-SiM, or NGTS
* High level of proficiency in developing and employing MBSE diagrams and techniques
  

  
  

**Scheduled Weekly Hours:**

40hrs

  
  

**Basic Compensation:**

The offered rate will be based on the selected candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities and/or experience and in consideration of internal parity.

  
  

Compensation for Hawaii is $158,000-$178,000.

  
  

**Additional Compensation:**

KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels, per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short term incentives, long term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.

  
  

**Ready to Make a Difference?**

If you’re excited about making a significant impact in the field of national defense and working on projects that matter, we encourage you to apply and join our team at KBR. Let's shape the future together.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

The Technical Program Manager (TPM) is the single accountable owner for delivering Kastle’s enterprise-platform programs and the complex, cross-functional technology work that runs alongside them. Reporting to the CIO, the TPM drives one unified plan, sequence, and cadence across every functional owner and implementation partner touching a program — from the ERP, CRM, CPQ, and HRIS rollouts through client integration deliveries.

Kastle’s Enterprise Technology Team is entering a concentrated window of platform work: a net-new ERP implementation, a CRM moving from selection into build, a live CPQ migration, and an HRIS improvement program. These programs have overlapping timelines, external implementation partners, and shared dependencies. The TPM is engaged at kickoff on any program that clears a defined complexity bar and stays accountable through go-live and into steady-state updates.

Responsibilities:

The programs you will own

**Platform**

**Scope of the work**

**ERP**

Net-new implementation with an external partner; migration off legacy financial systems; phased rollout across finance and operations.

**CRM**

Selection in final stages, moving directly into a net-new build and rollout; feeds downstream systems including CPQ.

**CPQ**

Live migration off the legacy platform (Expert Logic to Logik); parity work, experience enhancements, and Sales acceptance.

**HRIS**

Deployment of improvements and ongoing configuration and release management on the existing platform.

  
Qualifications:

These programs already intersect. For example, CPQ enhancement items are on hold pending CRM field definitions that the CRM program has not yet finalized. The TPM is the person who sequences dependencies like this deliberately, so they are planned rather than discovered late.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Enterprise platform delivery**
--------------------------------

* **Own deployment, configuration, and ongoing updates** across the enterprise platforms: ERP, CRM, CPQ, and HRIS, from kickoff through go-live and into steady-state release management.
* **Maintain a unified cross-program plan** and manage dependencies between platforms (for example, CPQ enhancements that depend on CRM field definitions) so they are sequenced deliberately.
* **Coordinate external implementation partners and internal functional owners** to a single plan, status, and risk view per program.
* **Run recurring cross-functional status reviews** across every owner on a given program, including vendors and partners.

**Client integration delivery**
-------------------------------

* **Own an end-to-end plan across client integration delivery** — install, integration, hardware, onboarding, and access — with a single point of accountability across workstreams.
* **Validate access as its own workstream** and confirm delivery-method and migration assumptions (for example, full export versus incremental) before they become execution risk.
* **Ensure source data and credential requirements are gathered before kickoff,** working from the scoping and requirements handed off by the paired Solutions Engineer function.

**Governance and risk**
-----------------------

* **Operationalize governance once adopted:** run RACI, rollback runbooks, and the Integration Review Board gate as live delivery mechanisms rather than paper artifacts.
* **Provide executive-ready reporting:** one authoritative status, risk, and dependency view per owned program, communicated directly to executive stakeholders and the CIO.

Other Eligibility Requirements:

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 5+ years of technical program or project management delivering complex, cross-functional technology programs with multiple functional owners and external partners.
* Demonstrated experience owning enterprise software implementations end to end — one or more of ERP, CRM, HRIS, or CPQ — including partner management, configuration, data migration, and phased rollout.
* Track record as a single accountable owner sequencing dependencies across concurrent programs.
* Fluency with integration and identity/access concepts (provisioning, SCIM/Entra, data reconciliation) sufficient to challenge delivery-method, migration, and access assumptions early.
* Experience standing up and running delivery governance: RACI, status cadences, review/gate mechanisms, and rollback planning.
* Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable driving reviews and reporting status directly to executive stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

jobs.description:
**Description**

**Who is USP?**

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

**Brief Job Overview**

The Associate Program Analyst serves as a key operational and programmatic partner to the Director and Equity Office team, supporting the implementation of the Equity Equals Excellence Strategy through project coordination, stakeholder engagement, research, communications, data analysis, and operational support. The position plays a critical role in translating strategic priorities into action by coordinating initiatives, maintaining systems and processes, supporting governance structures, and ensuring the effective execution of Equity Office programs and services.

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

**The Associate Program Analyst has the following responsibilities:**

* Collect, analyze, and interpret program, survey, and engagement data.

* Experience supporting senior leaders, directors, or executive-level initiatives in a complex organizational environment.

jobs.description:
**Senior Growth Operations Analyst**  
Hybrid

Blu Omega is seeking a Senior Growth Operations Analyst to support federal business development initiatives. This role is responsible for managing the pipeline forecast, maintaining compliance with federal registration and contracting requirements, and providing analytics to inform strategic growth decisions.

**Overview**  
Blu Omega supports mission-critical programs across civilian and defense sectors, partnering with federal agencies to deliver technology and cybersecurity solutions.

**Key Details**  
Location: Hybrid - Ashburn, VA

**Responsibilities**

* Maintain the business forecast, including pipeline, bookings, and probability assessments to support the company's annual growth plan.
* Contribute to pricing strategies, proposal development, and market data analysis.
* Deliver pipeline analytics by reporting coverage, conversion rates, velocity, and aging metrics to ensure the pipeline aligns with company targets.
* Conduct backlog and run-out analysis, tracking funding and flagging risks related to recompete and renewal opportunities.
* Conduct research using GovWin, SAM.gov, and agency forecasts to surface recompete opportunities and inform win strategies.
* Support pursuit efforts by managing CRM (Bullhorn), coordinating proposal inputs, and maintaining the past-performance library.
* Ensure compliance with SAM.gov registration, GSA Schedule management, and set-aside certifications, maintaining audit readiness.
* Lead data quality and workflow improvements, establishing standards, and coaching team members on best practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5–8 years in GovCon growth, business development operations, contracts administration, or related analytics roles, with experience in forecasting and process improvement.
* Hands-on experience with SAM.gov and GSA Schedule administration.
* Proficiency with GovWin, SAM.gov, GovTribe, and CRM tools (Bullhorn preferred).
* Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, modeling, and reporting.
* Knowledge of the federal business development lifecycle and past performance capture.
* Self-motivated with excellent attention to detail, capable of setting priorities independently and meeting deadlines.

**Compensation**  
Salary Range: $110,000.00 - $120,000.00
  
Final compensation is based on technical skills, experience, education, certifications, and clearance.

**Company Overview**  
Blu Omega is a Woman-Owned Small Business delivering cybersecurity and technology solutions to federal agencies and enterprise clients. Headquartered in Ashburn, VA, we support mission-critical programs across civilian and defense sectors, including health, national security, and regulatory environments. We partner with government agencies and large integrators to provide expertise in cybersecurity operations, cloud and infrastructure modernization, data analytics, and enterprise IT support.

**Benefits & Perks**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage through national providers
* 401(k) with company match (eligible after 6 months; vesting applies)
* Company-paid Life and AD&D insurance with additional voluntary options
* Short-term and long-term disability options
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with 24/7 support and mental health resources
* Telehealth and virtual care options
* Pet insurance, legal services, and identity theft protections
* Paid Time Off (PTO), paid federal holidays, and access to wellness programs, discounts, and lifestyle benefits

**Equal Opportunity Employer**  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

Define and track KPIs for member acquisition, conversion, engagement, and product usage.

Provide custom audience list pulls for various departments.
