Build audience models tailored to stakeholder needs.

Ensure proper tagging, tracking, and data integrity across digital platforms, including troubleshooting and validating analytics implementations.

Optimize data intake, validation, and mining processes; ensure effective modeling, visualization, and communication of outputs.

Develop automation procedures to streamline data collection and improve efficiency.

Create custom web behavior datasets to address data gaps in Salesforce and meet evolving needs of different teams.

Respond to data and analytics requests from departments across the Organization.

Deliver findings and recommendations that inform strategic decisions for internal and external stakeholders.

Support the development of reports and insights analyzing key operations and business functions.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist - US Government
jobs.description:
**A World-Changing Company**

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

### **The Role**

At its core, the Deployment Strategist role centers around leveraging data in operational and real-world action. Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to protect their troops, manufacture high-quality products, structure effective healthcare policies, or deliver aid to refugees safely is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into reality.  
  
If you believe in the transformational power of data and technology and in your own ability to bring that power to bear against complex problems, we want to meet you.

### **What We Do**

As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Engineers, Product Designers, and other Deployment Strategists to deploy software against the most challenging problems our world faces. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the data means, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be.
  
  
Deployment Strategists are do-ers who immerse themselves in our customers' most intricate workflows, partner with customer teams and explore the data, and dive into the product landscape to enable us to scale. A select number of Deployments Strategists may also be deployed to Palantir internal teams and problems. In this role, the problems you'll tackle will require a curious and analytical mindset, a sharp intuition for product, and a strong degree of user empathy to ultimately empower our customers to make better decisions.

### **No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to:**

* Go onsite and meet with customer analysts to understand the critical questions they need to answer and locate their biggest pain points.
* Identify relevant datasets through deep engagement with customer problems and workflows, and work with Forward Deployed Engineers to integrate the data into a stable and extensible pipeline.
* Work with the customer to build bespoke workflows for new user groups.
* Lead training sessions to ensure that the product is meeting user needs, and to ensure it is being used widely enough to have concrete impact on our partners' operations.
* Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from analysts to C-suite executives.
* Embed with our Software Engineering and Product Design teams to incorporate what you saw in the field into cross-Palantir product offerings.
* Build and deliver demos to new and existing customers.
* Scope out potential engagements in new industries and in increasingly expanding locations around the world.

### **What We Value**

* We value team members who aren’t satisfied with surface-level answers. We value the desire to dive into the details of the data because that’s the core of our work. And we value low ego because the outcome matters more than who gets the credit.
* Extraordinary ability to take on open-ended problems in unstructured environments.
* Adaptive and introspective; willing to learn, teach, lead and follow.
* Ability to travel 25 – 75% required. Varies by location and team.
* Experience with programming, scripting or statistical packages (e.g. Python, R, Matlab, SQL) is a plus.

### **What We Require**

* Active US Security Clearance at or above the Top Secret level.

**Salary**

The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $110,000 - $170,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.

Our benefits aim to promote health and wellbeing across all areas of Palantirians’ lives. We work to continuously improve our offerings and listen to our community as we design and update them. The list below details our available benefits and some of the perks that can be enjoyed as an employee of Palantir Technologies.

**Benefits**

* Employees (and their eligible dependents) can enroll in medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as voluntary life insurance

* Employees are automatically covered by Palantir’s basic life, AD&D and disability insurance

* Commuter benefits

* Relocation assistance

**Job Title: Senior Business Analyst – Post Trade**

**Location: London**

**About the Job you are considering:**

We're looking for an experienced Senior Manager to play a key role in shaping the future of our Post Trade consulting capability.

This role combines client delivery, business development, people leadership, and practice development, offering the opportunity to work directly with senior stakeholders across the financial services industry.

  

**Hybrid** **working** :

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

  

**Your Role**

* Lead and deliver complex Capital Markets transformation and regulatory change programmes for global financial services clients.
* Analyze, design, and implement solutions that improve post-trade operations, processes, controls, and operating models.
* Manage client engagements, ensuring successful project delivery while maintaining strong stakeholder relationships.
* Advise clients on regulatory initiatives, market changes, and industry best practices.
* Support business growth through proposal development, solution design, and contribution to sales campaigns.
* Identify emerging market and regulatory trends and translate them into client opportunities.
* Mentor, coach, and develop junior team members while contributing to practice growth and capability building.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, industry partners, and internal stakeholders.
Contribute to thought leadership, recruitment, and strategic initiatives across the Capital Markets practice.  

  
  

**Your Skills**

* Capital Markets Consulting
* Post Trade Processing
* Trade & Transaction Reporting (MiFID II, EMIR, CFTC, ASIC, MAS)
* Regulatory Change & Compliance
* CSDR & Accelerated Settlement
* Financial Market Infrastructure
* Project & Programme Management
* Business Analysis
* Target Operating Model Design
* Process Re-engineering & Transformation
* Data & Analytics
* Risk, Controls & Governance
* Client Relationship Management
* Solution Design & Delivery
* Business Development & Proposal Management
  

**We are a Disability Confident Employer:**

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

* Declare they have a disability, and
* Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

  

**Make It Real (what does it mean for you):**

* You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.
    
  To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
* You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 13 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.
  

**Why you should consider Capgemini:**

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

  

**About Capgemini:**

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. jobs.title: Real Estate Project Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role:**

You will support the client-side delivery of capital projects, including construction, fit-out and business-as-usual works. Working within agreed governance, you will coordinate scope, programme, quality, risk, change and stakeholder activities. You will provide project updates, oversee FM activities and collaborate with building services teams to ensure installation, commissioning and design standards are met. Partnering with internal teams, landlords, developers, contractors, designers and advisers, you will maintain project information, resolve day-to-day issues and escalate key decisions. You will also ensure required certifications, building control compliance and planning approvals are secured before completion and occupation.

**What your days will look like:**

  

* Coordinate projects and workstreams from initiation through to handover and aftercare, keeping plans, milestones and actions on track.
* Work closely with internal teams, landlords, developers, contractors and advisers to support delivery and communicate requirements clearly.
* Monitor scope, programme, quality and commercial commitments, identifying risks, issues and changes early and providing clear progress updates.
* Support supplier selection, mobilisation, inspections and handover, while maintaining effective project controls, approvals and decision records.

**This role is for you if:**

  

* You have experience supporting client-side delivery of real estate, construction, fit-out or refurbishment projects in a commercial environment.
* You understand construction procurement, change control, commercial administration and issue resolution.
* You have experience managing project programmes, progress reporting, risks and project controls.
* You can interpret construction programmes, scopes, specifications and architectural, mechanical and electrical drawings.
* You bring strong commercial judgement, analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the confidence to build relationships and constructively challenge stakeholders.
* You are organised and self-motivated, with a relevant degree or equivalent experience; professional accreditation, planning software knowledge and sustainability awareness are desirable.

**What you’ll receive from us:**

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.

We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Grow your career in a people-first consultancy

KSNPM is a growing multidisciplinary consultancy with nearly 30 years’ experience helping clients turn plans into successful buildings. We work across commercial, residential, healthcare, education and public-sector projects in the UK and Ireland, supporting developments from pre-construction, design and procurement through to delivery.

As we expand our London presence, we are looking for an ambitious Senior Project Manager who wants to make a visible impact and grow with the business. You will join a close-knit, supportive team where people are trusted to solve problems, encouraged to share ideas and recognised for their contribution.

A culture where people can thrive

We combine the family feel of a smaller business with the variety and opportunity of an expanding consultancy. Expectations are high, but so is the support. Our people value integrity, collaboration and strong relationships, creating a professional yet enjoyable workplace where personality matters.

You will have the freedom to take ownership, build trusted client relationships and contribute to the direction of our growing UK business. Whether you are leading an assurance review, guiding a client through a complex risk or mentoring a colleague, your work will be valued.

Development that moves with your ambitions

This role offers broad exposure to project controls, cost management, commercial governance and risk assurance across major capital projects. Working across different sectors and assignments will help you deepen your technical expertise while strengthening the judgement, confidence and leadership skills needed for your next career step.

Your development will be actively supported through ongoing CPD, training, further educational assistance and support towards MRICS accreditation. You will learn from experienced colleagues, take on increasing responsibility and have clear opportunities to progress as the consultancy grows.

What you’ll do

· Review project controls, cost reports, forecasts and commercial processes.

· Assess budgets, change management, contingency use and governance compliance.

· Identify cost, schedule, procurement and delivery risks and produce clear recommendations.

· Support project assurance reviews, commercial health checks and executive reporting.

· Build trusted relationships through stakeholder interviews, workshops and practical problem-solving.

What you’ll bring

You will have extensive experience in project controls, quantity surveying, cost management, construction audit, commercial management or capital project assurance. You will combine strong analytical and reporting skills with commercial awareness, confidence with clients and a proactive approach. Familiarity with NEC and JCT contracts, London developments and progress towards MRICS accreditation would be advantageous.

What we offer

· Competitive salary and performance-related bonus.

· Generous annual leave.

· Ongoing CPD, training and educational support.

· Exposure to a diverse portfolio of significant projects.

· Clear career progression within an ambitious, expanding consultancy.

**Ready to take the next step?** Send your CV to gkinrade@fexco.com

Pay: From £65,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

DXC Technology is committed to building diverse, inclusive teams. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and particularly encourage interest from women, underrepresented groups, and neurodivergent candidates. We offer reasonable adjustments throughout the hiring process and are dedicated to creating a supportive, accessible environment for everyone.

  

**Senior Project Manager**

**Location: Hampshire (onsite 5 days per week)**

  

**Due to the nature of the work and the customers we support, the successful candidate must be eligible to meet UK Government and contractual personnel security requirements, including the applicable residency requirements for the role, and have the right to work in the United Kingdom. Some roles may also be subject to nationality requirements where these are necessary to meet UK Government or contractual security obligations.**

  

We are looking for an experienced Project Manager / Programme Manager to lead the end-to-end transition into a new programme within a complex IT service management environment. This is a senior, delivery-focused role requiring strong programme governance, customer engagement and operational leadership. The successful candidate will take ownership of transition planning and execution, ensuring contractual commitments, programme milestones, operational requirements and governance standards are met.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Provide end-to-end governance and leadership for transition into the new programme, ensuring activities are delivered in accordance with contractual obligations, Customer requirements and DXC standards.
* Establish and maintain an effective transition governance framework, including appropriate controls, reporting, escalation routes, quality gates and decision-making forums.
* Ensure transition activities remain aligned with the wider DXC programme and the Customer's strategic and operational objectives.
* Develop, baseline and maintain detailed transition schedules, ensuring key milestones, dependencies, critical-path activities and deliverables are understood and actively managed.
* Own the transition RAID framework, maintaining a comprehensive Risks, Actions, Issues and Decisions log.
* Drive risks and issues through to resolution, ensuring clear ownership, mitigation actions, target dates and appropriate escalation.
* Identify potential delivery blockers early and coordinate the appropriate SMEs and decision-makers to resolve them.
* Manage cross-functional dependencies between technical, operational, process, commercial and business workstreams.
* Undertake or coordinate deep-dive analysis where issues are complex, ensuring actions address root causes rather than symptoms.
* Act as the primary transition point of contact between the Customer and DXC, establishing trusted and effective working relationships across both organisations.
* Lead stakeholder engagement at project, programme and leadership levels, adapting communication appropriately for technical, operational and executive audiences.
* Chair and facilitate daily stand-ups, weekly programme synchronisation meetings, governance reviews and ad hoc working sessions.
* Ensure meetings and governance forums are outcome-focused, with decisions, owners and actions clearly captured and followed through.
* Drive operational alignment between programme workstreams and SMEs, ensuring teams understand how their deliverables contribute to successful transition.
* Proactively unblock delivery teams, bringing the appropriate stakeholders together to resolve cross-functional problems.
* Ensure all transition artefacts, plans, RAID items, decisions, approvals and supporting documentation are maintained within a controlled repository as the agreed single source of truth.
Establish and maintain appropriate document control, versioning, approval and audit disciplines.  

  

**What you’ll bring**

  

* Strong project/programme management skills within complex IT environments.

* Good knowledge of ITIL, ITSM and service transition practices.

* Strong planning, RAID management, risk mitigation and issue-resolution capability.

* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation and influencing skills.

* Ability to manage multiple workstreams, SMEs and cross-functional dependencies.

* Strong governance, reporting and documentation disciplines.

* Experience with tools such as MS Project, SharePoint and Teams.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a delivery-focused approach.

* High attention to detail, particularly around compliance, audit readiness and documentation.

* Proven experience as a Project Manager, Programme Manager, Delivery Lead or Service Management Lead within major ITSM transition or transformation programmes.

* Demonstrable experience delivering complex service transitions for major customers.

* Experience of walk-in takeover, service commencement or rapid transition programmes would be highly desirable.

* Experience leading cross-functional technical, process, service management and business teams.

* Strong background in structured governance, reporting, escalation and stakeholder management.

* Experience onboarding teams into new operating processes, quality gates and documentation standards.

* Experience within high-security, government, defence or regulated environments is desirable.

* Relevant project/programme management and ITIL qualifications would be advantageous.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

jobs.title: Credit Risk Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Date live: 13/10/2026

Business Area: Private Bank Processing

Area of Expertise: Change

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000113405

  

Join us at Barclays as a Credit Risk Data Analyst. As part of the A-IRB Programme, you will support the delivery of critical regulatory objectives by translating business and regulatory requirements into clear requirements, data specifications, and solution designs. Working across business, risk, and technology teams, you will drive requirements capture, stakeholder engagement, data analysis, and support testing and governance activities to enable successful A-IRB implementation.

To be successful as a Credit Risk Data Analyst, you should have experience with:

* Solid business & data analysis capability, including translating regulatory (IRB) requirements into structured requirements and data specifications
* Experience working with credit risk data (e.g. PD, LGD, EAD) and understanding data lineage, quality, and controls
* Experience in IRB / Basel / regulatory change programmes or similar risk transformation initiatives
* Ability to engage stakeholders across business, risk and technology to gather, challenge and refine requirements

Some other highly valued skills may include:

* Knowledge of data tooling, data modelling, or MI/reporting environments
* Experience working in structured delivery environments (e.g. L0–L3 requirements, Agile or large-scale programmes)

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role can be based in Canary Wharf, Northampton or Glasgow.

**Purpose of the role**

To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.

**Accountabilities**

* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
* Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
* Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
* Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
* Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

jobs.title: Lead Data Analyst - Treasury Operations
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.  
**For everyone, everywhere.**

More about **our mission** and **what we offer**.

 **Job Description**

We are looking for a Lead Data Analyst to join the Treasury Analytics team at Wise.

This role offers an opportunity to have a direct and measurable impact on Wise’s mission — money without borders. Built by and for people who live global lives. This analyst will be responsible for supporting the Treasury functions that onboard and maintain relationships with our banking partners as well as the Corporate Treasury Operations team, responsible for moving and investing our corporate cash.

This is an IC3 role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here.

**What you'll be doing**

* Help corporate treasury teams make more effective operational and investment decisions through deep-dive analyses and performance measurement
* Automate relevant operational processes to free up time for strategic initiatives (includes supporting the design of engineering solutions when needed)
* Build and maintain dbt data models to surface key metrics to the teams
* Build and maintain Lightdash dashboards to support decision making and operational processes
* Build relationships with teams across the company, from finance and engineering to our customer support, operations, design and more, to gain the knowledge needed for accurate analysis and implementation of analytics solutions
* Mentor other team members on best practices in data analysis, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and reproducibility of work while improving the pace of execution

**What you'll bring**

* Extensive experience in data analytics
* Extensive experience using SQL to build and maintain complex data sources, and leveraging visualisation tools to surface critical insights
* Experience with dbt and robust data modelling, including the ability to navigate complex dbt projects and create reusable, maintainable data assets for scalable analytics
* Stakeholder management skills; you know how to influence teams to deliver high-impact change, across analytics, engineering, and business specialists
* Ability to translate business requests into clear analytical problems
* Ability to convey complex information, tailored to the audience’s level of understanding
* Ability to deliver high quality work autonomously

**Nice to have**

* Experience working in Fintech or Financial Services
* Experience automating (or supporting) operational processes
* Experience using Lightdash or Superset
* Knowledge of advanced analytics techniques, including the use of Python and statistical modelling
* Experience managing 1-2 analysts or coaching more junior team members

 **Additional Information**

**Some of our benefits:**

Base salary of £75,000 - £115,000

RSU's in a growing and public company

Private Medical Insurance + Life Insurance

️ Discounted gym memberships and cycle to work scheme

️ A paid 6-week sabbatical leave after four years

26 weeks maternity leave at full pay

An annual self-development budget

Pet friendly offices

* ️ Lots of fun group activities like yoga, running and boardgame nights

Find out more about our benefits in our London office.

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

**About the Role:**

We are seeking a curious and commercially minded Data Analyst to join our growing team at CompassRock. While this role is based in the residential rental sector, we actively welcome applications from professionals with experience in hospitality, airlines, or broader real estate industries—particularly those who bring a passion for elevating customer experience through data-driven decisions.

Our mission is to redefine urban renting—delivering a seamless, service-led living experience. Your analysis will directly inform pricing strategies, marketing performance, resident satisfaction, leasing effectiveness, and broader commercial planning across our portfolio.

**Company Overview:**

CompassRock provides asset and property management services to the rental housing sector. Originally founded in the U.S., the company has expanded to the UK and is rapidly growing its portfolio of Build-to-Rent (BTR) assets across England and Europe. Backed by private equity, CompassRock is in an exciting growth phase, actively acquiring and developing new assets at a fast pace. With an entrepreneurial and innovative culture embedded in its DNA, the company values the dynamic, forward-thinking individuals it employs. As CompassRock continues to expand, there will be abundant opportunities for career advancement and professional development.

**What You'll Do:**

* Leverage large datasets to generate actionable insights around resident behaviour, leasing trends, retention, and demand drivers.
* Support the leasing and revenue teams by identifying opportunities for rent optimization, concession planning, and lead conversion improvement.

* Benchmark operational and service KPIs—occupancy, turnaround times, customer service touchpoints—across sites or regions.
* Translate data into clear visual dashboards and compelling presentations for senior stakeholders.

**Who We're Looking For:**

* Proven analytical experience in BTR, hospitality, airlines, hotels, or real estate.
* Experience in building and structuring datasets or data cubes to support scalable reporting and analytics—ideally with a view to implementing BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI. Proficient in working with large datasets using tools like SQL and Excel.
* A commercial mindset with the ability to link data insights to real business outcomes.
* Strong communication skills—you know how to turn complex numbers into actionable recommendations.
* Curious, collaborative, and highly adaptable.

**Bonus if you have:**

* Experience in revenue management, pricing analytics, or marketing attribution.
* Exposure to customer or guest satisfaction data (e.g. NPS, reviews, feedback tools).
* Previous work with leasing systems or property management software.

jobs.title: People Operations Analyst - 12 Month FTC
jobs.description:
PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients’ capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world’s largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk-adjusted returns.

Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.

**Role Overview**

The People Operations Analyst is an early-career role for someone interested in helping build the future of People Operations. The Analyst will deliver accurate, responsive and employee-centered HR services while using technology, data, knowledge and continuous improvement practices to make those services simpler, more scalable and easier to navigate.

This role combines hands-on operational delivery with future-focused problem solving. The Analyst will support employee inquiries and lifecycle processes, identify recurring issues and friction, partner with subject matter experts to clarify rules and exceptions, and help translate operational needs into improved processes, knowledge, self-service and responsible AI or automation use cases.

Success requires strong attention to detail, sound judgment, curiosity and a willingness to learn. The ideal candidate can operate within established controls while also asking thoughtful questions, navigating ambiguity and contributing ideas that improve the employee experience and the way People Operations delivers its work.

**What You Will Do**

**Employee and Manager Support**

* Respond to employee and manager inquiries with empathy, accuracy and appropriate urgency across HR policies, processes and programs.
* Manage cases through the HR service management platform, document actions clearly and support delivery against service expectations.
* Research issues, distinguish routine questions from exceptions and escalate sensitive or higher-risk matters appropriately.
* Look beyond case closure to understand the employee need, remove confusion where possible and create a consistent service experience.

**Employee Lifecycle Operations**

* Execute and coordinate core employee lifecycle activities, including onboarding, transfers, mobility, changes and offboarding.
* Complete HR transactions and documentation accurately, maintaining data integrity, confidentiality, compliance and audit-ready records.
* Coordinate across People Operations, HR Business Partners, Subject Matter Experts, and other partners to support timely outcomes.
* Identify unclear handoffs, recurring delays or process gaps and raise practical recommendations for improvement.

**Digital Enablement, AI and Automation**

* Use approved AI and digital tools to support research, drafting, summarization, analysis and operational delivery, with appropriate human review.
* Identify repetitive, manual or high-friction activities that may benefit from standardization, self-service, automation or AI enablement.
* Help define practical use cases by documenting the business problem, users, process, required data, risks, controls and desired outcome.
* Participate in testing new tools and workflows, document findings and provide clear feedback on accuracy, usability and employee impact.
* Apply sound judgment regarding confidential information, data quality, bias, accuracy and when human or subject matter expert review is required.
* Stay curious about emerging tools and share relevant, practical ideas that could improve People Operations.

**Process Improvement and Operational Insight**

* Review workflows, case themes, employee feedback and available service data to identify root causes and improvement opportunities.
* Map current processes, clarify decision points and exceptions, and help design simpler and more consistent ways of working.
* Contribute to process documentation, standard operating procedures, controls and measurement approaches.
* Support implementation of improvements and assess whether changes reduced effort, improved quality or created a better employee experience.

**Knowledge Management and Self-Service**

* Create, update and maintain clear, accurate and accessible knowledge articles for employees, managers and HR colleagues.
* Partner with subject matter experts to translate policies and specialist knowledge into practical guidance, decision logic and employee-friendly content.
* Identify knowledge gaps based on recurring inquiries and recommend content or self-service improvements.
* Help ensure knowledge remains current, consistent across channels and aligned with global standards and regional requirements.

**Partnership and Navigation of Ambiguity**

* Build effective working relationships across People Operations and with HR and business partners.
* Approach unfamiliar or ambiguous situations by gathering facts, identifying what is known and unknown, assessing risk and proposing a path forward.
* Engage subject matter experts with focused questions and relevant context rather than simply passing work to another team.
* Balance employee experience, consistency, speed, risk and practicality when evaluating options.
* Know when to act independently, when to seek guidance and when escalation is required.

**Employee Experience and Service Excellence**

* Consider the employee and manager experience at each stage of a process, including the clarity, accessibility and tone of communications.
* Listen for signals of confusion

Alpha Data Services is seeking a highly motivated Senior Business Analyst to support the growth and strategic evolution of the Account & Reference Data Management practice.

The role will work closely with Product, Architecture, Technology, Operations, EDM and Client Implementation teams to define, document, govern, and enhance account and reference data capabilities across the Alpha platform.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager - Treasury Safeguarding
jobs.description:
Salary: 90000 - 115000 GBP Annual

* London

Company Description

  
  

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**

More about **our mission** and **what we offer**.

  
  

Job Description

  
  

We're looking for an Implementation Manager to join our fast-growing Finance & Treasury Product team in London or Tallinn. This is a unique opportunity to have an impact on Wise's mission by making sure our customers' money stays safe as we launch new products and expand into new markets.

**Your mission**

Wise customers trust us to keep their money safe. Safeguarding is how we make sure that every penny we hold for customers is protected, in every country we operate in.

Today we run safeguarding across 11 legal entities and client asset protection (CASS) across 6. That means more than 500 bank accounts in scope, 5+ external audits a year, regular internal audit and regulator reviews, and several new legal entities launching every year.

As Wise grows, so does our Safeguarding team. Our global team builds and runs the automated controls and tools that every entity relies on, while regional teams own what happens locally. As the Implementation Manager, you'll connect the two. You'll make sure new products and entities are onboarded into our controls properly, and that incidents are handled quickly and transparently.

You'll work closely with the Safeguarding Product Manager, Safeguarding Engineering and Analytics, Treasury and Regulatory Product Compliance, Finance, Payment and Treasury Operations, and regional controllers around the world.

  

**How you'll contribute to our mission**

**New product reviews, onboarding and approval**

* Run the safeguarding review and approval process for new products and product changes, making sure every step is followed and nothing launches without the right controls in place.

* Follow up with product teams, Treasury Regulatory Product Compliance and Finance to keep projects moving.

* Keep a clear, up-to-date tracker of projects that need safeguarding support, and report on their status.

  

**New entity launches**

* Support new legal entities as they launch, working out how they'll be onboarded into our global systems and controls.

* Define how controls need to be set up locally for each entity, for example safeguarding timings.

* Work with Regional Finance and Compliance so that local controllers are ready to take ownership from day one.

  

**Execution and implementation**

* Plan and lead the work to integrate new Wise products into our safeguarding systems, together with product managers, engineers, data analysts and operations specialists.

* Own large, complex integrations from start to finish, and support the team with clear documentation: requirements, project plans, resourcing, testing and delivery.

  

**Support**

* Keep documentation of product flows and safeguarding calculations up to date.

* Get hands-on when things go wrong: help product and engineering teams understand the impact of an incident, drive it to resolution, and improve controls so it doesn't happen again.

  
  

Qualifications

  
  

**A bit about you**

* You know regulated finance. You have experience in implementation, controls, regulatory operations or treasury operations in financial services or fintech, and you're used to working alongside Compliance to launch things the right way.

* You understand how customer money is protected. You know safeguarding, client money/CASS or a similar framework for protecting customer funds. If you know one regime well and are keen to learn others, that works too.

* You enjoy getting deep into the processing logic. You're comfortable with reconciliations, ledgers and financial data. You like to understand in depth how money flows through a product and what it depends on, and you can explain what a reconciliation break means and why it matters.

* You create clarity. You bring people together behind a common goal, balance different points of view and bring structure to complex problems. You write clearly, and you can explain complex concepts in simple terms to engineers, compliance specialists, finance teams and senior stakeholders without losing the nuance.

* You get it done. You keep many workstreams moving across teams and time zones without losing track of the details. You hold others to account without being their line manager, and you follow things through to the end.

* You stay calm when things go wrong. You make sound calls during incidents, and you know when to escalate.

  

**Some extra skills that are great (but not essential)**

* Experience supporting external or internal audits, or regulator inspections.

* Experience with control frameworks, obligation-to-control mapping or risk tools.

* Working knowledge of SQL or data tools (e.g. Looker, Snowflake) for investigating issues yourself.

* Experience launching a new regulated entity or a new market.

* Familiarity with safeguarding rules in more than one region (UK, EU, APAC, North America).

  
  

Additional Information

  
  

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Royal International Construction** is a relatively new name in the UAE's vibrant construction scene, but it is one that harnesses the strengths and heritage of its founders and the expert talents of its proactive management team. The company currently employs over 500 construction experts located throughout the UAE, with an unparalleled skillset covering finance, architecture, design, mechanical and electrical engineering, as well as project management. We also have an in-house team dedicated to producing high-standard technical bids and comprehensive and competitive commercial tenders.

**Summary:**

The Project Manager is responsible for leading, managing, and delivering construction projects from

initiation to completion. The role oversees project planning, budgeting, execution, and handover while

ensuring compliance with design specifications, quality standards, timelines, and safety regulations. It

involves coordinating multidisciplinary teams, managing client relationships, and ensuring successful

delivery of projects within scope, cost, and schedule.

**Location:** Dubai

**What will it be like to work for United Al Saqer Group?**

Established more than 37 years ago, the United Al Saqer Group (UASG) is one of the leading multi-sector business groups in the United Arab Emirates. The UASG owns and operates a diverse yet complementary portfolio of six UAE-based companies encompassing a number of key industry sectors, which includes Abu Dhabi Motors, Dalma Motors, Al Saqer Heavy Equipment, Al Saqer Property Management, Awraq Islamic Financial Brokerage, Royal International Construction, and Royal Joinery.

  + Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, consultants, and contractors.

* **Team Leadership & Resource Management**
  + Lead multidisciplinary teams including engineers, supervisors, and subcontractors.

* **Risk Management & Issue Resolution**
  + Identify project risks, develop mitigation strategies, and implement contingency plans.
  + Resolve technical, contractual, and operational issues promptly.

* **Reporting &Documentation**

* Maintain comprehensive project records including schedules, drawings, correspondence, and reports.
* Prepare and present progress reports, KPI tracking, and executive summaries.
* Ensure timely preparation of as-built drawings and handover documentation.

* Bachelor’s degree in civil, Structural, or Construction Engineering; master’s degree is an advantage.
* PMP or equivalent project management certification preferred.
* Minimum 20–25 years of experience in villa projects, /Projects Requirements
* Minimum of 8–10 years of experience in construction project management, with minimum of 2 to 3 years of experience in a leadership role within the relevant field is required

* Strong leadership, negotiation, and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in project management tools such as Primavera, MS Project, and MS Office Suite.

**Skills & Competencies (Technical, Behavioral and Soft)**

**Technical Skills:**

* Project Planning & Scheduling
* Budgeting & Cost Control
* Contract & Risk Management
* Quality & Safety Compliance
* Stakeholder & Client Coordination

jobs.title: Insider Threat Program Analyst
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**INSIDER THREAT PROGRAM ANALYST**

SpaceX is seeking a dynamic and driven individual with a demonstrated ability to work independently and as a member of a team in a fast-paced, high-tech environment. Our goal is to protect some of the world's most advanced technologies including rockets, Dragon capsules for human transport, inter-planetary transport vehicles, the world's largest satellite communications network, etc. As an industry leader, we are a target of adversaries, both foreign and domestic, focused on slowing us down and accessing our proprietary technology. The work we do will literally safeguard mankind becoming an interplanetary species.

You will be responsible for the research, analysis, production, and dissemination of information relevant to protecting the safety and security of personnel, brand, global assets, intellectual property, and operations at SpaceX. This role will triage anomalous event data and analyze insider threat program datasets to respond to threats posed to SpaceX. You will use comprehensive understanding of various collection methods and platforms to explore new data sources, build effective queries, and combine information from disparate sources.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Conduct comprehensive investigations and analysis in support of SpaceX intellectual property and security
* Uphold investigation and analytic tradecraft standards including confidentiality, objectivity, lawfulness, timeliness, and use of all available sources of information
* Collect and analyze available program data to evaluate insider threat risk to SpaceX infrastructure, programs, and operations
* Triage anomalous event data associated with indicators of data exfiltration, data destruction and other key indicators of concern
* Conduct internal investigations working with Information Security, HR, Legal, Government Security, Physical Security, and external partners based on information derived from internal and external sources
* Utilize network monitoring, data analytic, and other tools (DLP/SIEM/UEBA) to identify anomalous activity, initiate investigations and decipher underlying trends
* Extract and organize insider threat program data to build metrics, reports and case studies addressing mission requirements and timelines
* Communicate findings in a timely and accurate manner to team members, management, and relevant stakeholders
* Support employee training and briefings for internal and external audiences
* Liaise with external industry and government partners to benchmark insider threat program, share threat intelligence, and further investigations
* Continuously identify and help implement program improvement methods
* Manage and safeguard sensitive information, including case files, employee PII, and intelligence reports

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree and 2+ years of professional experience in internal investigations, information security, or counterintelligence; OR 4+ years professional experience in information security, internal investigations, or counterintelligence in lieu of a degree

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* 1+ year using a SIEM and/or conducting digital forensic investigations in a government or corporate environment
* Working level understanding of insider threat program missions, internal stakeholders, and manifestations of insider threats
* Proficiency in Microsoft Purview for eDiscovery
* Experience performing business process automation or constructing data pipelines
* Familiarity with risk-based alerting, detection, and tuning concepts for insider risk
* Experience conducting preliminary assessments, determining scope, investigation planning, evidence collection/handling, interviewing and reporting findings to internal and external stakeholders
* Ability to conduct interviews on short notice according to established internal guidelines.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to produce clear and concise reports
* Highly organized with a strong attention to detail
* Ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines
* Can swiftly adapt to new technical environments and workflows
* Ability to exercise discretion when conducting confidential investigations

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Must be able to work extended hours and weekends as needed to support critical efforts and operations
* Must be willing to travel ad hoc
* Active TS/SCI clearance, or ability to obtain one. With an active clearance, candidates will be subject to pre-employment screening including background check and drug/alcohol test as well as random drug and alcohol testing during employment

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**  
  
Pay Range:  
Level 1: $85,000 - $110,000  
Level 2: $100,000 - $135,000

  

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. jobs.description:
General Statement of Job:

The Senior Information Security Analyst is a senior individual contributor responsible for advancing SIS's information security program and for leading the company's effort to achieve and maintain ISO 27001 certification. This individual owns the day-to-day operation of the Information Security Management System (ISMS)—risk assessment, control implementation, policy development, internal audit readiness, and evidence collection—and serves as the primary respondent to client cyber security surveys, questionnaires, and third-party assessments. The role is measured by steady, incremental progress against SIS's published security objectives across the cloud, identity, endpoint, and network environment, as well as the physical security technologies deployed at SIS offices and at client sites monitored by the Fusion Center. SIS operates a predominantly Apple environment (approximately 90% macOS) supporting a 24/7 Global Security Operations Center. The Senior Information Security Analyst works within an ITIL-based operational framework and reports directly to the Director of Technology.

This is an individual contributor role without direct reports. The Senior Information Security Analyst operates as a peer to the Senior Manager of IT Infrastructure and Senior Manager of Applications and works closely with the IT Infrastructure, Applications, Help Desk, and Fusion Center teams to implement and validate security controls across the enterprise. The position carries functional authority for security requirements and compliance obligations, influencing technical direction through subject matter expertise rather than direct supervision.

Essential Job Functions:

* Design and maintain security reference architectures and technical security standards across the cloud, identity, endpoint, network, application, and physical security domains, and review proposed designs and infrastructure changes against them (15%)
* Administer, tune, and monitor security tooling in partnership with the Senior Cloud Administrator, including endpoint detection and response (SentinelOne), vulnerability management, email security, data protection, and a Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) solution, ensuring alerts are actionable and triaged (10%)
* Own vulnerability management and remediation across endpoints, infrastructure, and cloud services, including patch currency, device encryption, configuration hardening, and periodic least-privilege access reviews (10%)
* Build and automate security operations through scripting and platform integration, including continuous control monitoring, automated evidence collection, access review workflows, and alert enrichment, reducing reliance on manual, point-in-time compliance effort (10%)
* Support security incident response, including investigation, containment coordination, documentation, root cause analysis, and post-incident reporting, working closely with IT Infrastructure and Fusion Center leadership (5%)
* Conduct security reviews of enterprise business applications, including Salesforce, Sage Intacct, the enterprise workforce management platform, and internally developed applications, covering role and permission models, segregation of duties, data sharing and export controls, API and integration credentials, audit logging, and data retention (5%)
* Establish secure development and application security requirements for custom and client-facing applications, including secure coding standards, dependency and vulnerability scanning, penetration testing cadence, and remediation tracking with internal development and vendor teams (5%)
* Drive onboarding of enterprise applications to centralized identity, including Single Sign-On and automated provisioning, and conduct periodic application-level access reviews and offboarding validation (2%)
* Contribute information security and technical expertise to the standards and longer-term strategy for physical security technologies in use at SIS offices and at client sites monitored by the Fusion Center, including video management and camera platforms, access control and badge systems, and emerging AI-based detection and video analytics capabilities, in partnership with the Director of Technology, Fusion Center leadership, and other system owners (5%)
* Ensure physical security systems are deployed and maintained in line with information security requirements, including network segmentation, device hardening, credential and certificate management, firmware currency, centralized logging, and data retention and privacy obligations (5%)
* Perform security review of new technologies, vendors, and contracts, including third-party risk assessment and review of security exhibits and data protection terms (3%)
* Lead SIS's ISO 27001 certification effort end to end, including scoping and the Statement of Applicability, gap assessment against Annex A controls, hands-on implementation and configuration of the technical controls, internal audit, remediation of findings, and successful completion of the Stage 1 and Stage 2 certification audits (TEMPORARY, FIRST ~8 MONTHS)
* Operate and mature the Information Security Management System on an ongoing basis, maintaining the risk register and risk treatment plans, coordinating management review, tracking corrective actions, and preparing the organization for annual surveillance audits and recertification (5%)
* Serve as the primary respondent for client cyber security surveys, security questionnaires, and third-party risk assessments (for example, CAIQ, SIG, and custom client formats), maintaining a curated answer library and evidence repository, and converting identified gaps and client commitments into tracked remediation items driven to closure with the responsible technical owners (5%)
* Define, measure, and report on SIS's security objectives and key security metrics, delivering visible incremental improvement quarter over quarter and reporting progress to tech

Program Manager
  
  
***Location:***  
Princeton, NJ or Los Angeles, CA (currently hybrid) - 2 days per week in the office. Must be local to one of our offices, others will not be considered.

Director, Program Management

$80,000 – $120,000. Exact compensation will vary based on experience

Vaccination against COVID-19 is a prerequisite for employment at CHDI Management  
  
***About CHDI Foundation, Inc.***  
CHDI Foundation, Inc. is a privately funded nonprofit biomedical research organization exclusively dedicated to collaboratively developing therapeutics that will substantially improve the lives of those affected by Huntington’s disease (HD). Our scientists work closely with a network of more than 700 researchers in academic and industrial laboratories around the world in the pursuit of these novel therapies, providing strategic scientific direction to ensure that our common goals remain in focus. This helps bridge the translational gap that often exists between academic and industrial research pursuits and that adds costly delays to therapy development. In its role as a collaborative enabler, CHDI seeks to bring the right partners together to identify and address critical scientific issues and move drug candidates to clinical evaluation as rapidly as possible. Our activities extend from exploratory biology to the identification and validation of therapeutic targets, and from drug discovery and development to clinical studies and trials. More information about CHDI can be found at www.chdifoundation.org.

We are seeking a highly motivated and organized Program Manager to join the preclinical Program Management Office supporting various preclinical teams. The candidate should have strong experience in the coordination and management of translational and preclinical studies. In addition, the candidate should be very detail-oriented and have significant experience working with Ph.D. level scientists. The position offers significant growth opportunities, exposure to a new model of non-profit orphan disease drug discovery, and an entrepreneurial work environment with high impact.

==============

Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

**What We Do**
==============

First American Trust is seeking an experienced Business Analyst to support our growing Payments function across multiple payment rails, including ACH, wire transfers, instant payments, and future payment capabilities.  
  
This individual will use strong business, operational, and analytical skills to evaluate payment processes, analyze payment activity and trends, identify operational gaps and inefficiencies, support new payment capabilities, and help improve the scalability and effectiveness of the bank's payment operations. The Business Analyst will partner closely with Payments Operations, payment program owners and subject matter experts, Risk/Compliance, Treasury Management, Product, Technology, Finance, and other business areas. This role provides analytical and operational support across payment rails and does not serve as the program owner or day-to-day processor for a specific payment method.

**What You'll Do:**
-------------------

* Develop a strong understanding of the bank's end-to-end payment processes across ACH, domestic and international wires, instant payments, and other current or future payment rails.
* Analyze payment workflows to identify operational gaps, inefficiencies, manual processes, capacity constraints, control opportunities, and areas for improvement.
* Analyze payment volumes, values, exceptions, returns, rejects, processing times, service levels, manual interventions, and other operational data to identify trends and emerging issues.
* Develop reporting, metrics, dashboards, and management information that provide visibility into payment operations, performance, capacity, and trends.
* Perform root-cause analysis of recurring payment issues to distinguish individual exceptions from broader process or operational problems.
* Evaluate processes across different payment rails to identify opportunities for greater consistency, standardization, efficiency, and scalability.

jobs.description:

Katten is a full-service law firm with approximately 650 attorneys in locations across the United States and in London and Shanghai. Clients seeking sophisticated, high-value legal services turn to Katten for counsel locally, nationally and internationally. Reporting to the Information Security Manager, the Information Security Analyst monitors, investigates, and responds to security events across the organization while helping improve threat detection, incident response, and data protection capabilities. The Analyst independently investigates security concerns, identifies emerging threats, and recommends practical enhancements to strengthen the Firm's security posture. Maintains professionalism and strict confidentiality in all client and Firm matters.

**The Information Security Analyst can be located in our Chicago, Charlotte, Dallas, New York, Los Angeles or Washington D.C. office.** Katten offers a hybrid work model, allowing the flexibility to work both on-site and remotely on a regular basis (KattenFlex).

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** include, but may not be limited to, the following. Other duties may be requested and/or assigned. Essential functions are primary job duties that an individual must be able to perform successfully with or without a reasonable accommodation. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Analyze security logs and correlate data from multiple sources to identify suspicious or anomalous activity.
* Conduct proactive threat hunting and identify indicators of compromise before they develop into larger incidents.
* Investigate DLP, endpoint, XDR/EDR, and Zscaler alerts, documenting findings and escalating issues as appropriate.
* Support incident response activities, including evidence collection, analysis, containment, remediation, and post-incident review.
* Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, application, and business stakeholders on investigations and risk mitigation efforts.
* Assist in developing and enhancing detection rules, alerts, monitoring processes, and security controls.

**Job Function Summary**

Involves gathering, analyzing, and interpreting a wide variety of research data. Designs and conducts research including selecting data samples, developing research instruments, analyzing collected information according to established statistical methods, and developing recommendations based on research findings. Prepares reports, charts, tables, and other visual aids to interpret and communicate data and results.

**Generic Scope**

Entry-level professional with limited prior experience; learns to use professional concepts to resolve problems of limited scope and complexity; works on assignments that are initially routine in nature, requiring limited judgment and decision making. Employees at this level are expected to acquire the skills and knowledge to perform more advanced work following an agreed upon time in position, through defined training and development planning.

Under direct supervision, acquires skills and knowledge of professional concepts in research data analysis. Works on small projects or segments of projects with limited scope and complexity.

**Department Overview**

The Department of Radiology & Biomedical Imaging is one of the largest departments within the School of Medicine, generating more than $40 million in professional fee revenues each year, and submitting grant proposals resulting in $30-40 million of awards each year. More than 90% of the MD faculty in Radiology is based at the Parnassus Campus, including nine of the ten clinical sections and their chiefs, and five of the seven vice chairs. The department has significant clinical and research operations at China Basin, Mission Bay, the VAMC, ZSFG, and Mount Zion. It includes more than 150 academic personnel and approximately 225 staff FTE. In addition, there are more than 90 resident, fellow, and graduate student trainees.

The Research Data Anl 1 position is focused on the collection of clinical data focused on patients treated with PSMA radioligand therapy and peptide receptor radionuclide therapy. A multicenter database is being created to collect data on these patients to understand toxicity, efficacy and see how these drugs are used clinically. Reporting to the Executive Director-Strategic Initiatives, the Project Manager-Grant Funded Initiatives (PT Exempt Remote) provides leadership and oversight for the day-to-day execution of a multi-year grant-funded initiative at the college. This position is responsible for managing project scope, schedule, budget, deliverables, and outcomes to ensure alignment with institutional priorities and grant objectives.

The Project Manager exercises independent judgment and initiative in managing project operations, including setting priorities, allocating resources, making operational decisions, mitigating risk, and resolving issues to ensure successful achievement of project objectives and compliance with institutional and funding requirements.

This is a fully remote position and is grant funded through September 30, 2028. All duties and responsibilities are expected to be performed virtually.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

* Direct and manage a complex, multi-year grant-funded initiative, providing overall leadership and accountability for managing project scope, schedule, budget, deliverables, and outcomes to ensure alignment with institutional priorities and grant objectives.
* Lead all phases of the project lifecycle, including project charter development, strategic planning, implementation, performance monitoring, risk mitigation, issue resolution, change management, and project closeout.
* Establish effective project governance structures, decision-making processes, and performance frameworks to ensure successful project execution, stakeholder engagement, and achievement of project goals.
* Develop and manage comprehensive project plans, timelines, workstreams, resource allocations, and performance measures, proactively identifying dependencies, constraints, and opportunities to optimize project performance.
* Serve as the primary liaison to executive leadership, grant sponsors, external partners, and cross-functional stakeholders, facilitating collaboration, influencing decision-making and ensuring alignment on project priorities and deliverables.
* Monitor project budgets, expenditures, and resource utilization to ensure compliance with grant requirements, institutional policies, and funding expectations.
* Establish and evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs), success metrics, and project outcome measures to assess effectiveness, support strategic decision-making, and demonstrate project impact.
* Lead cross-functional teams by assigning responsibilities, monitoring progress, facilitating collaboration, and promoting accountability for project deliverables.
* Prepare and present executive-level reports, recommendations, and project status updates to senior leadership, funding agencies, and other key stakeholders.
* Analyze project outcomes and organizational impact, recommending process improvements, sustainability strategies, and opportunities to expand or replicate successful practices.
* Utilize project management methodologies, tools, and best practices to ensure efficient project execution, stakeholder engagement, and operational effectiveness in a fully remote environment.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, customer service excellence, accountability, and collaboration while maintaining professionalism, confidentiality, and adherence to City Colleges of Chicago policies and standards.
* Perform related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelors degree from an accredited college or university required
* Minimum of three (3) years of progressively responsible professional experience required, preferably in project management, program management, grant administration, or a related field.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered at the discretion of management.
* Employees working remotely are responsible for providing a stable internet environment with a connection speed of at least 300 megabytes per second (Mbps).
* Demonstrated knowledge and experience managing grant-funded projects or complex initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, preferably within a higher education, government, or other complex organization.
* Knowledge of project management principles, methodologies, and tools required.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare reports, presentations and other communications for diverse audiences.
* Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing project needs.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in a fully remote work environment.
* Demonstrated commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and student success.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams).

Salary: $32,500 annually

Offered salary will be determined by the applicant's education, knowledge, skills and abilities, as well as other factors such as internal equity.

Benefits information is found at https://www.ccc.edu/departments/Benefits/

We are an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.

**It’s not just a job. It’s a mission.**

Altruix is a high-touch pharmacy dedicated to serving behavioral health and intellectual and developmental disability populations. Through our pharmacy expertise, and specialized packaging, we promote medication adherence and improve patient outcomes. Our services help clients take medications as prescribed while reducing administrative burden for providers. Altruix customers achieve measurable results, including 90% adherence rates and a 40% reduction in ER and hospital-related costs. Learn more at www.altruix.com.

Altruix is seeking a hands-on **Project Manager - M&A Integration & De Novo Pharmacy Builds** to lead the execution of pharmacy acquisitions, integrations, De Novo builds, and relocations. This role translates approved growth opportunities into actionable project plans and drives execution from pre-close or initial planning through launch, stabilization, and transition to ongoing operations. The Project Manager coordinates cross-functional teams, maintains accountability for milestones and deliverables, identifies and escalates risks, and supports multiple concurrent projects while strengthening Altruix’s repeatable M&A and De Novo implementation processes.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own integrated project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and deliverables, ensuring clear ownership and accountability across workstreams
* Lead project kickoffs, workstream reviews, and readiness meetings; document decisions and drive timely resolution of action items, risks, and dependencies
* Maintain project dashboards, risk and issue tracking, and leadership reporting, clearly communicating status, decisions needed, and recovery plans
* Coordinate cross-functional work across Operations, Clinical and Quality, Legal and Compliance, Finance, HR, IT, Revenue Cycle, Payer, Licensing, Facilities, Procurement, Sales, Marketing, 340B, and Logistics

  

**De Novo Builds and Pharmacy Relocations:**

* Translate approved opportunities into project scope, budgets, launch plans, timelines, and readiness requirements, escalating material changes to cost, timing, staffing, or scope
