* Manage pharmacy relocations and De Novo launches, ensuring licensing, payer, staffing, technology, patient transition, and operational dependencies are addressed before opening

  

**M&A Integration:**

* Build and manage transaction-specific integration plans based on deal structure, locations, licensing, payer enrollment, workforce, systems, contracts, and operational requirements
* Coordinate seller information requests and pre-close planning in accordance with Legal-approved access and confidentiality requirements
* Drive Day 1 readiness and post-close integration through stabilization, coordinating employee onboarding, financial and billing continuity, procurement, technology, supplier transitions, communications, and operating workflows
* Coordinate system migrations, testing, cutover, contingency planning, and operational support to minimize disruption to patient and client service

  

**Launch Readiness and Continuous Improvement:**

* Coordinate functional readiness signoffs and escalate unresolved regulatory, patient-safety, payer, security, financial, or operational risks before launch
* Lead launch support, issue resolution, stabilization reviews, and formal handoff to ongoing Operations
* Monitor project performance against approved scope, schedule, budget, and operating objectives; capture lessons learned and continuously improve implementation playbooks and templates

  

**Success Metrics:**

* Success is demonstrated through reliable milestone delivery, clear cross-functional accountability, controlled scope and budget, launch readiness, continuity of patient and client service, effective issue resolution, and successful transition to ongoing operations

  

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare administration, project management, or related field, or equivalent relevant experience
* 5+ years of project management or implementation experience leading complex, cross-functional projects involving multiple departments, vendors, or locations
* Experience in healthcare, pharmacy operations, acquisitions/integrations, facility openings, or other regulated environments strongly preferred
* Strong planning, facilitation, communication, problem-solving, and follow-through skills with the ability to influence across functional teams
* Proficiency with Excel and project management tools, including schedules, dashboards, budgets, and action tracking

* PMP or equivalent certification preferred
* Behavioral health or long-term care pharmacy, pharmacy system conversions, construction coordination, and/or 340B experience preferred

  

**Travel Expectations:**

* Paid holidays

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Global Strategic Accounts
new_jobs.description:
Founded by Arianna Huffington in 2016, Thrive Global is a leading behavior change technology company with the mission to improve productivity and health outcomes – one Microstep at a time. Thrive helps individuals and organizations improve well-being, performance and mental resilience with its AI-powered behavior change technology platform. Thrive’s Microsteps – small, science-backed steps to improve health and productivity – have been adopted by employees at more than 230 organizations in over 160 countries, from frontline and call center workers to executives at multinational companies. For more information, visit www.thriveglobal.com.

The Program Manager is responsible for program planning, cross-functional coordination, and reporting & program insights for one of Thrive’s largest global enterprise accounts.

This role turns account strategy into a coordinated program across engagement campaigns, coaching, content, and regional priorities. The Program Manager develops the roadmap, sets milestones and success measures, and uses data and stakeholder feedback to improve the program over time.

The Program Manager works closely with the Account Director, who owns account strategy and commercial outcomes, and the Operations Manager, who leads day-to-day delivery and manages the global team of Wellbeing Coordinators and Health Coaches.

**How You'll Contribute**

**Program Strategy & Planning**

* Translate account priorities into program plans with clear objectives, timelines, responsibilities, and success measures.
* Coordinate and maintain the global content and engagement roadmap, including quarterly themes, campaigns, and program initiatives.
* Own the master program calendar, coordinating dependencies across regions, teams, and client stakeholders.
* Establish a consistent global approach while accounting for regional needs.
* Partner with the Operations Manager to ensure plans reflect delivery capacity, resource needs, and realistic timelines.

**Data, Reporting & Business Reviews**

* Manage account reporting, working with Data and other internal teams to validate inputs, resolve discrepancies, and maintain consistent metric definitions.
* Maintain dashboards and reporting that show engagement, utilization, program outcomes, and progress against agreed performance commitments.
* Analyze results to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, and recommend improvements.
* Coordinate quarterly and annual business reviews, preparing reporting, insights, and supporting materials for the Account Director.
* Track program capacity and commitments to inform planning and prioritization.

**Program Development & Optimization**

* Bring the full range of Thrive offerings, including content, coaching, live sessions, and campaigns, into one integrated roadmap aligned to account goals and employee needs.
* Partner with the Operations Manager and teams across Coaching and Content to increase awareness, participation, and utilization.
* Oversee and evaluate engagement tactics, with clear goals, success measures, and recommendations for broader rollout.
* Use participant feedback and performance data to refine program initiatives over time.

**Cross-Functional & Client Coordination**

* Facilitate planning sessions with internal teams and client stakeholders, turning the Account Director’s priorities into clear decisions, owners, and next steps.
* Partner with the Operations Manager to turn program plans into clear delivery requirements for regional teams.
* Assess new requests against program goals, timelines, scope, and available capacity.
* Bring recommendations to the Account Director when requests require changes to priorities, scope, or resources.
* Incorporate feedback from the client and regional teams into future plans.

**Who You Are**

* You know how to build awareness and participation across a large, diverse employee population.
* You bring structure to complex programs and turn broad goals into achievable plans.
* You have strong analytical skills and understand what drives employee engagement.
* You build productive relationships across teams and keep stakeholders aligned.
* You spot dependencies and risks early and bring practical recommendations.
* You take ownership of program outcomes and work closely with delivery teams to turn plans into results.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university required.
* 5+ years of experience managing programs in enterprise client services, employee engagement, internal communications, or a related field.
* Experience planning and running ongoing programs across multiple regions or large employee populations.
* Experience building engagement or communications plans that drive awareness and participation through campaigns, events, content, and other channels.

Established in 2008, Brightway is proud to be one of the fastest-growing insurance agency systems in the United States. * Franchise Conversions — Brightway acquires an independent agent’s book of business, and the agent converts their existing agency into a Brightway franchise.
* Book Acquisitions — Brightway jointly purchases a book of business with an existing Brightway franchisee.

Business Analyst – Client Solutions

We are seeking a motivated and business-minded **Business Analyst – Client Solutions** to join our team.

This is a **client-facing sales and business development position**. The primary responsibility is to identify and develop your own prospective business clients, understand the challenges they are facing, and determine whether our company can provide solutions to help improve their financial position, cash flow, financing structure, or overall business strategy.

**Important:** This is not a traditional back-office analyst position. The company does **not** provide a pre-existing list of client names, phone numbers, or guaranteed leads. Candidates must be comfortable prospecting, networking, making outbound calls, developing referral relationships, and building their own client pipeline.

Responsibilities

* Identify and prospect new small and mid-sized business clients
* Build and maintain your own pipeline through outbound calls, networking, referrals, and other business development activities
* Speak directly with business owners to understand their operations, financial challenges, and business goals
* Analyze each client's situation and identify the key problems affecting their business
* Review business needs such as cash flow, working capital, debt, expansion, equipment purchases, and other financial challenges
* Determine whether our company has a suitable solution for the client's needs
* Present appropriate financial and business solutions to prospective clients
* Follow up with prospects and guide qualified clients through the process
* Develop long-term relationships with business owners and referral partners
* Maintain accurate records of prospects, conversations, opportunities, and follow-ups in the company's CRM
* Work with management and operations teams to structure solutions for qualified clients
* Meet individual sales, prospecting, and business development goals

What We're Looking For

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Comfortable speaking with business owners and decision-makers
* Sales-oriented and motivated to develop new business
* Ability to prospect and find potential clients independently
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
* Ability to understand a business owner's challenges and recommend practical solutions
* Organized and comfortable managing multiple prospects and follow-ups
* Previous experience in sales, business development, financial services, consulting, banking, lending, or B2B services is preferred
* CRM experience is a plus

Who Will Succeed in This Role

This position is a strong fit for someone who enjoys **sales, problem-solving, and working directly with business owners**.

You should be comfortable starting conversations with new prospects, asking questions to understand how their business operates, identifying financial or operational challenges, and turning those conversations into business opportunities.

If you are looking for a traditional analyst position where clients and assignments are provided to you, this position may not be the right fit.

**Description**

**Who is USP?**

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

**Brief Job Overview**

The Associate Program Analyst serves as a key operational and programmatic partner to the Director and Equity Office team, supporting the implementation of the Equity Equals Excellence Strategy through project coordination, stakeholder engagement, research, communications, data analysis, and operational support. The position plays a critical role in translating strategic priorities into action by coordinating initiatives, maintaining systems and processes, supporting governance structures, and ensuring the effective execution of Equity Office programs and services.

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

* Collect, analyze, and interpret program, survey, and engagement data.
* Maintain program dashboards, evaluation measures, and performance tracking systems.

* Support special projects and other duties as assigned.

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the below competencies and experience.

* Bachelor's degree in Public Administration, Education, Organizational Development, Human Resources, Communications, Social Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field.

* Demonstrated ability to organize, analyze, and communicate information effectively to diverse audiences.
* Experience using Qualtrics or similar survey platforms to create surveys, manage data collection, analyze results, and prepare reports

* Experience supporting organizational culture, employee engagement, equity, inclusion, belonging, learning, or organizational effectiveness initiatives.
* Experience supporting senior leaders, directors, or executive-level initiatives in a complex organizational environment.
* Experience with survey platforms, performance measurement, data analysis, and reporting.

**Senior Growth Operations Analyst**  
Hybrid

Blu Omega is seeking a Senior Growth Operations Analyst to support federal business development initiatives. This role is responsible for managing the pipeline forecast, maintaining compliance with federal registration and contracting requirements, and providing analytics to inform strategic growth decisions.

**Overview**  
Blu Omega supports mission-critical programs across civilian and defense sectors, partnering with federal agencies to deliver technology and cybersecurity solutions.

**Key Details**  
Location: Hybrid - Ashburn, VA

**Responsibilities**

* Maintain the business forecast, including pipeline, bookings, and probability assessments to support the company's annual growth plan.
* Contribute to pricing strategies, proposal development, and market data analysis.
* Deliver pipeline analytics by reporting coverage, conversion rates, velocity, and aging metrics to ensure the pipeline aligns with company targets.
* Conduct backlog and run-out analysis, tracking funding and flagging risks related to recompete and renewal opportunities.
* Conduct research using GovWin, SAM.gov, and agency forecasts to surface recompete opportunities and inform win strategies.
* Support pursuit efforts by managing CRM (Bullhorn), coordinating proposal inputs, and maintaining the past-performance library.
* Ensure compliance with SAM.gov registration, GSA Schedule management, and set-aside certifications, maintaining audit readiness.
* Lead data quality and workflow improvements, establishing standards, and coaching team members on best practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5–8 years in GovCon growth, business development operations, contracts administration, or related analytics roles, with experience in forecasting and process improvement.
* Hands-on experience with SAM.gov and GSA Schedule administration.
* Proficiency with GovWin, SAM.gov, GovTribe, and CRM tools (Bullhorn preferred).
* Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, modeling, and reporting.
* Knowledge of the federal business development lifecycle and past performance capture.
* Self-motivated with excellent attention to detail, capable of setting priorities independently and meeting deadlines.

**Compensation**  
Salary Range: $110,000.00 - $120,000.00
  
Final compensation is based on technical skills, experience, education, certifications, and clearance.

**Company Overview**  
Blu Omega is a Woman-Owned Small Business delivering cybersecurity and technology solutions to federal agencies and enterprise clients. Headquartered in Ashburn, VA, we support mission-critical programs across civilian and defense sectors, including health, national security, and regulatory environments. We partner with government agencies and large integrators to provide expertise in cybersecurity operations, cloud and infrastructure modernization, data analytics, and enterprise IT support.

**Benefits & Perks**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage through national providers
* 401(k) with company match (eligible after 6 months; vesting applies)
* Company-paid Life and AD&D insurance with additional voluntary options
* Short-term and long-term disability options
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with 24/7 support and mental health resources
* Telehealth and virtual care options
* Pet insurance, legal services, and identity theft protections
* Paid Time Off (PTO), paid federal holidays, and access to wellness programs, discounts, and lifestyle benefits

**Equal Opportunity Employer**  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

**About the job**

Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade-offs in product development with engineers.  
  
Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage various Engineering-specific programs and teams.

As Manager for Energy Contracts and Asset Management, you will guide, orchestrate, and optimize strategic, complex programs across EMEA and globally. Serving as an advanced subject-matter expert and advocate to executive stakeholders, you will align leadership on portfolio direction and drive programs that directly impact Google's energy portfolio scale.

Operational Architecture and leadership to establish continuous improvement systems, lead AI/ML automation at scale, and coach, mentor, and develop a high-performing program team.

By translating ambiguous organizational goals into clear, delegatable workstreams, you will enhance productivity, foster innovation, and build vital cross-functional alliances.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. The GSMA is at the heart of the modern mobile communications ecosystem. These systems are rightly considered critical to national infrastructure, and our members defend themselves and their consumers from cyber, networking and fraud / scam attacks every minute of every day.

The T-ISAC team brings together the defence analysts from across the mobile world to share intelligence and produce actionable, timely and relevant outputs that help ensure the resilience and operational strength of our communication infrastructure. We believe that threat detection from one mobile network operator should serve to help to better defend industry peers and consumers.

  

The Telecommunication Information Sharing and Analysis Center (T-ISAC) is the cybersecurity threat intelligence community for the telecommunication industry, dedicated to facilitating collaboration and intelligence sharing among mobile network operators, mobile virtual network operators and industry stakeholders. T-ISAC provides GSMA members with critical cyber threat intelligence, fostering a trusted environment where telecommunication stakeholders can proactively address cybersecurity threats and reduce risks through the development of best practices. new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.  
**For everyone, everywhere.**

More about **our mission** and **what we offer**.

 **Job Description**

We are looking for a Lead Data Analyst to join the Treasury Analytics team at Wise.

This role offers an opportunity to have a direct and measurable impact on Wise’s mission — money without borders. Built by and for people who live global lives. This analyst will be responsible for supporting the Treasury functions that onboard and maintain relationships with our banking partners as well as the Corporate Treasury Operations team, responsible for moving and investing our corporate cash.

This is an IC3 role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here.

**What you'll be doing**

* Help corporate treasury teams make more effective operational and investment decisions through deep-dive analyses and performance measurement
* Automate relevant operational processes to free up time for strategic initiatives (includes supporting the design of engineering solutions when needed)
* Build and maintain dbt data models to surface key metrics to the teams
* Build and maintain Lightdash dashboards to support decision making and operational processes
* Build relationships with teams across the company, from finance and engineering to our customer support, operations, design and more, to gain the knowledge needed for accurate analysis and implementation of analytics solutions
* Mentor other team members on best practices in data analysis, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and reproducibility of work while improving the pace of execution

**What you'll bring**

* Extensive experience in data analytics
* Extensive experience using SQL to build and maintain complex data sources, and leveraging visualisation tools to surface critical insights
* Experience with dbt and robust data modelling, including the ability to navigate complex dbt projects and create reusable, maintainable data assets for scalable analytics
* Stakeholder management skills; you know how to influence teams to deliver high-impact change, across analytics, engineering, and business specialists
* Ability to translate business requests into clear analytical problems
* Ability to convey complex information, tailored to the audience’s level of understanding
* Ability to deliver high quality work autonomously

**Nice to have**

* Experience working in Fintech or Financial Services
* Experience automating (or supporting) operational processes
* Experience using Lightdash or Superset
* Knowledge of advanced analytics techniques, including the use of Python and statistical modelling
* Experience managing 1-2 analysts or coaching more junior team members

 **Additional Information**

**Some of our benefits:**

Base salary of £75,000 - £115,000

RSU's in a growing and public company

Private Medical Insurance + Life Insurance

️ Discounted gym memberships and cycle to work scheme

️ A paid 6-week sabbatical leave after four years

26 weeks maternity leave at full pay

An annual self-development budget

Pet friendly offices

* ️ Lots of fun group activities like yoga, running and boardgame nights

Find out more about our benefits in our London office.

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

new_jobs.description:
**About the Role:**

We are seeking a curious and commercially minded Data Analyst to join our growing team at CompassRock. While this role is based in the residential rental sector, we actively welcome applications from professionals with experience in hospitality, airlines, or broader real estate industries—particularly those who bring a passion for elevating customer experience through data-driven decisions.

Our mission is to redefine urban renting—delivering a seamless, service-led living experience. Your analysis will directly inform pricing strategies, marketing performance, resident satisfaction, leasing effectiveness, and broader commercial planning across our portfolio.

**Company Overview:**

CompassRock provides asset and property management services to the rental housing sector. Originally founded in the U.S., the company has expanded to the UK and is rapidly growing its portfolio of Build-to-Rent (BTR) assets across England and Europe. Backed by private equity, CompassRock is in an exciting growth phase, actively acquiring and developing new assets at a fast pace. With an entrepreneurial and innovative culture embedded in its DNA, the company values the dynamic, forward-thinking individuals it employs. As CompassRock continues to expand, there will be abundant opportunities for career advancement and professional development.

**What You'll Do:**

* Leverage large datasets to generate actionable insights around resident behaviour, leasing trends, retention, and demand drivers.
* Support the leasing and revenue teams by identifying opportunities for rent optimization, concession planning, and lead conversion improvement.
* Monitor and analyse digital marketing channel performance (e.g. PPC, aggregators, OTAs), particularly for lease-ups and new openings.

* Benchmark operational and service KPIs—occupancy, turnaround times, customer service touchpoints—across sites or regions.
* Translate data into clear visual dashboards and compelling presentations for senior stakeholders.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, leasing, revenue management and operations to improve the end-to-end resident experience.

**Who We're Looking For:**

* Proven analytical experience in BTR, hospitality, airlines, hotels, or real estate.
* Experience in building and structuring datasets or data cubes to support scalable reporting and analytics—ideally with a view to implementing BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI. Proficient in working with large datasets using tools like SQL and Excel.
* A commercial mindset with the ability to link data insights to real business outcomes.
* Strong communication skills—you know how to turn complex numbers into actionable recommendations.
* Curious, collaborative, and highly adaptable.

**Bonus if you have:**

* Experience in revenue management, pricing analytics, or marketing attribution.
* Exposure to customer or guest satisfaction data (e.g. NPS, reviews, feedback tools).
* Previous work with leasing systems or property management software.

**Renumeration / Bonuses / Benefits**

* Salary: Competitive
* Bonuses: Discretionary Bonus Scheme
* Benefits: a) Company Pension Scheme; b) Vitality Private Healthcare Insurance; c) Company Sick Pay; d) Bike to Work Scheme
* Working Hours: 40 hour working week
* Job Type: Full-time, Permanent, 4x work from the office, 1x WFH
* Location: Oxford Street, London (Corporate Head Office)

**Equal Opportunities Statement**

We are an Equal Opportunities Employer, committed to creating an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We provide equal opportunities for everyone and offer reasonable adjustments to ensure all candidates have a fair chance during the recruitment process.

### **Company Overview**

CompassRock provides asset and property management services to the rental housing sectors. Originally founded in the U.S., the company has expanded to the UK and is rapidly growing its portfolio of Build-to-Rent (BTR) assets across the UK and Ireland. Backed by private equity, CompassRock is in an exciting growth phase, actively acquiring and developing new assets at a fast pace. With an entrepreneurial and innovative culture embedded in its DNA, we value the dynamic, forward-thinking individuals it employs.

new_jobs.title: People Operations Analyst - 12 Month FTC
new_jobs.description:
PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients’ capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world’s largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk-adjusted returns.

Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.

**Role Overview**

The People Operations Analyst is an early-career role for someone interested in helping build the future of People Operations. The Analyst will deliver accurate, responsive and employee-centered HR services while using technology, data, knowledge and continuous improvement practices to make those services simpler, more scalable and easier to navigate.

This role combines hands-on operational delivery with future-focused problem solving. The Analyst will support employee inquiries and lifecycle processes, identify recurring issues and friction, partner with subject matter experts to clarify rules and exceptions, and help translate operational needs into improved processes, knowledge, self-service and responsible AI or automation use cases.

Success requires strong attention to detail, sound judgment, curiosity and a willingness to learn. The ideal candidate can operate within established controls while also asking thoughtful questions, navigating ambiguity and contributing ideas that improve the employee experience and the way People Operations delivers its work.

**What You Will Do**

**Employee and Manager Support**

* Respond to employee and manager inquiries with empathy, accuracy and appropriate urgency across HR policies, processes and programs.
* Manage cases through the HR service management platform, document actions clearly and support delivery against service expectations.
* Research issues, distinguish routine questions from exceptions and escalate sensitive or higher-risk matters appropriately.
* Look beyond case closure to understand the employee need, remove confusion where possible and create a consistent service experience.

**Employee Lifecycle Operations**

* Execute and coordinate core employee lifecycle activities, including onboarding, transfers, mobility, changes and offboarding.
* Complete HR transactions and documentation accurately, maintaining data integrity, confidentiality, compliance and audit-ready records.
* Coordinate across People Operations, HR Business Partners, Subject Matter Experts, and other partners to support timely outcomes.
* Identify unclear handoffs, recurring delays or process gaps and raise practical recommendations for improvement.

**Digital Enablement, AI and Automation**

* Use approved AI and digital tools to support research, drafting, summarization, analysis and operational delivery, with appropriate human review.
* Identify repetitive, manual or high-friction activities that may benefit from standardization, self-service, automation or AI enablement.
* Help define practical use cases by documenting the business problem, users, process, required data, risks, controls and desired outcome.
* Participate in testing new tools and workflows, document findings and provide clear feedback on accuracy, usability and employee impact.
* Apply sound judgment regarding confidential information, data quality, bias, accuracy and when human or subject matter expert review is required.
* Stay curious about emerging tools and share relevant, practical ideas that could improve People Operations.

**Process Improvement and Operational Insight**

* Review workflows, case themes, employee feedback and available service data to identify root causes and improvement opportunities.
* Map current processes, clarify decision points and exceptions, and help design simpler and more consistent ways of working.
* Contribute to process documentation, standard operating procedures, controls and measurement approaches.
* Support implementation of improvements and assess whether changes reduced effort, improved quality or created a better employee experience.

**Knowledge Management and Self-Service**

* Create, update and maintain clear, accurate and accessible knowledge articles for employees, managers and HR colleagues.
* Partner with subject matter experts to translate policies and specialist knowledge into practical guidance, decision logic and employee-friendly content.
* Identify knowledge gaps based on recurring inquiries and recommend content or self-service improvements.
* Help ensure knowledge remains current, consistent across channels and aligned with global standards and regional requirements.

**Partnership and Navigation of Ambiguity**

* Build effective working relationships across People Operations and with HR and business partners.
* Approach unfamiliar or ambiguous situations by gathering facts, identifying what is known and unknown, assessing risk and proposing a path forward.
* Engage subject matter experts with focused questions and relevant context rather than simply passing work to another team.
* Balance employee experience, consistency, speed, risk and practicality when evaluating options.
* Know when to act independently, when to seek guidance and when escalation is required.

**Employee Experience and Service Excellence**

* Consider the employee and manager experience at each stage of a process, including the clarity, accessibility and tone of communications.
* Listen for signals of confusion

**Role Summary**

Alpha Data Services is seeking a highly motivated Senior Business Analyst to support the growth and strategic evolution of the Account & Reference Data Management practice.

The role will work closely with Product, Architecture, Technology, Operations, EDM and Client Implementation teams to define, document, govern, and enhance account and reference data capabilities across the Alpha platform.

The successful candidate will be responsible for analysing business requirements, documenting target operating models, defining governance controls, identifying data quality improvements, and supporting the delivery of strategic initiatives including Account Resolution, Automated Account Creation, Account Governance, Benchmark Governance, Entity Mastering, Account Health Monitoring, and Reference Data Services.

This role requires strong business analysis skills, a detailed understanding of asset management operating models, and experience working with account, security, benchmark, portfolio, and reference data domains

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

Business Analysis & Requirements Management

* Elicit, analyse and document business, operational and data requirements.
* Facilitate workshops across clients, operations, product, technology and implementation teams.
* Produce business requirements documents, functional specifications and user stories.
* Document current-state and target-state operating models.
* Translate strategic objectives into detailed business and data requirements.
* Support prioritisation activities aligned to the Account & Reference Data roadmap.

  
  

**Account & Reference Data Governance**

**Support governance and control frameworks across:**

* Account Master Data
* Account Hierarchies and Group Structures
* Benchmark Relationships
* Fund Relationships
* Account Classifications
* Lifecycle Status Management
* Security-to-Account Relationships
* Cross Reference Management
* Source-to-Consumer Data Lineage
* Distribution Controls and Fit-for-Purpose Rules

* Automated Account Creation capabilities.
* Shell Account governance models.
* Account enrichment and validation workflows.

* Exception management frameworks.
* Fit-for-purpose release criteria.

* Define remediation workflows and ownership models.

* Governance Frameworks
* Data Standards

* Policy Documentation

* Fund Matrix Reconciliation Views

* Workflow Impact Analysis
* Audit and Control Reporting

**Project & Change Delivery**

* Support strategic change initiatives across the Account & Reference Data domain.
* Manage requirements through the delivery lifecycle.
* Coordinate testing and business validation activities.
* Support implementation planning and change management.
* Contribute to roadmap planning and prioritisation.
  

  

**Key Deliverables**

* Account Resolution Operating Models.
* Automated Account Creation Frameworks.
* Account Governance Standards.
* Benchmark Governance Frameworks.
* EDM Configuration Requirements.
* Data Quality Rule Libraries.
* Client Onboarding Requirements.
* Account Health Dashboards.
* Reference Data Governance Controls.
* Account Hierarchy and Relationship Models.
* Business Cases and Roadmap Proposals.
* Executive Steering Committee Materials.

new_jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager - Treasury Safeguarding
new_jobs.description:
Salary: 90000 - 115000 GBP Annual

* London

Company Description

  
  

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**

More about **our mission** and **what we offer**.

  
  

Job Description

  
  

We're looking for an Implementation Manager to join our fast-growing Finance & Treasury Product team in London or Tallinn. This is a unique opportunity to have an impact on Wise's mission by making sure our customers' money stays safe as we launch new products and expand into new markets.

**Your mission**

Wise customers trust us to keep their money safe. Safeguarding is how we make sure that every penny we hold for customers is protected, in every country we operate in.

Today we run safeguarding across 11 legal entities and client asset protection (CASS) across 6. That means more than 500 bank accounts in scope, 5+ external audits a year, regular internal audit and regulator reviews, and several new legal entities launching every year.

As Wise grows, so does our Safeguarding team. Our global team builds and runs the automated controls and tools that every entity relies on, while regional teams own what happens locally. As the Implementation Manager, you'll connect the two. You'll make sure new products and entities are onboarded into our controls properly, and that incidents are handled quickly and transparently.

You'll work closely with the Safeguarding Product Manager, Safeguarding Engineering and Analytics, Treasury and Regulatory Product Compliance, Finance, Payment and Treasury Operations, and regional controllers around the world.

  

**How you'll contribute to our mission**

**New product reviews, onboarding and approval**

* Run the safeguarding review and approval process for new products and product changes, making sure every step is followed and nothing launches without the right controls in place.

* Follow up with product teams, Treasury Regulatory Product Compliance and Finance to keep projects moving.

* Keep a clear, up-to-date tracker of projects that need safeguarding support, and report on their status.

  

**New entity launches**

* Support new legal entities as they launch, working out how they'll be onboarded into our global systems and controls.

* Define how controls need to be set up locally for each entity, for example safeguarding timings.

* Work with Regional Finance and Compliance so that local controllers are ready to take ownership from day one.

  

**Execution and implementation**

* Plan and lead the work to integrate new Wise products into our safeguarding systems, together with product managers, engineers, data analysts and operations specialists.

* Own large, complex integrations from start to finish, and support the team with clear documentation: requirements, project plans, resourcing, testing and delivery.

  

**Support**

* Keep documentation of product flows and safeguarding calculations up to date.

* Get hands-on when things go wrong: help product and engineering teams understand the impact of an incident, drive it to resolution, and improve controls so it doesn't happen again.

  
  

Qualifications

  
  

**A bit about you**

* You know regulated finance. You have experience in implementation, controls, regulatory operations or treasury operations in financial services or fintech, and you're used to working alongside Compliance to launch things the right way.

* You understand how customer money is protected. You know safeguarding, client money/CASS or a similar framework for protecting customer funds. If you know one regime well and are keen to learn others, that works too.

* You enjoy getting deep into the processing logic. You're comfortable with reconciliations, ledgers and financial data. You like to understand in depth how money flows through a product and what it depends on, and you can explain what a reconciliation break means and why it matters.

* You create clarity. You bring people together behind a common goal, balance different points of view and bring structure to complex problems. You write clearly, and you can explain complex concepts in simple terms to engineers, compliance specialists, finance teams and senior stakeholders without losing the nuance.

* You get it done. You keep many workstreams moving across teams and time zones without losing track of the details. You hold others to account without being their line manager, and you follow things through to the end.

* You stay calm when things go wrong. You make sound calls during incidents, and you know when to escalate.

  

**Some extra skills that are great (but not essential)**

* Experience supporting external or internal audits, or regulator inspections.

* Experience with control frameworks, obligation-to-control mapping or risk tools.

* Working knowledge of SQL or data tools (e.g. Looker, Snowflake) for investigating issues yourself.

* Experience launching a new regulated entity or a new market.

* Familiarity with safeguarding rules in more than one region (UK, EU, APAC, North America).

  
  

Additional Information

  
  

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.J

Our goal is to protect some of the world's most advanced technologies including rockets, Dragon capsules for human transport, inter-planetary transport vehicles, the world's largest satellite communications network, etc. As an industry leader, we are a target of adversaries, both foreign and domestic, focused on slowing us down and accessing our proprietary technology. You will be responsible for the research, analysis, production, and dissemination of information relevant to protecting the safety and security of personnel, brand, global assets, intellectual property, and operations at SpaceX. General Statement of Job:

The Senior Information Security Analyst is a senior individual contributor responsible for advancing SIS's information security program and for leading the company's effort to achieve and maintain ISO 27001 certification. This individual owns the day-to-day operation of the Information Security Management System (ISMS)—risk assessment, control implementation, policy development, internal audit readiness, and evidence collection—and serves as the primary respondent to client cyber security surveys, questionnaires, and third-party assessments. The role is measured by steady, incremental progress against SIS's published security objectives across the cloud, identity, endpoint, and network environment, as well as the physical security technologies deployed at SIS offices and at client sites monitored by the Fusion Center. SIS operates a predominantly Apple environment (approximately 90% macOS) supporting a 24/7 Global Security Operations Center. The Senior Information Security Analyst works within an ITIL-based operational framework and reports directly to the Director of Technology.

This is an individual contributor role without direct reports. The Senior Information Security Analyst operates as a peer to the Senior Manager of IT Infrastructure and Senior Manager of Applications and works closely with the IT Infrastructure, Applications, Help Desk, and Fusion Center teams to implement and validate security controls across the enterprise. The position carries functional authority for security requirements and compliance obligations, influencing technical direction through subject matter expertise rather than direct supervision.

Essential Job Functions:

* Design and maintain security reference architectures and technical security standards across the cloud, identity, endpoint, network, application, and physical security domains, and review proposed designs and infrastructure changes against them (15%)
* Administer, tune, and monitor security tooling in partnership with the Senior Cloud Administrator, including endpoint detection and response (SentinelOne), vulnerability management, email security, data protection, and a Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) solution, ensuring alerts are actionable and triaged (10%)
* Own vulnerability management and remediation across endpoints, infrastructure, and cloud services, including patch currency, device encryption, configuration hardening, and periodic least-privilege access reviews (10%)
* Build and automate security operations through scripting and platform integration, including continuous control monitoring, automated evidence collection, access review workflows, and alert enrichment, reducing reliance on manual, point-in-time compliance effort (10%)
* Support security incident response, including investigation, containment coordination, documentation, root cause analysis, and post-incident reporting, working closely with IT Infrastructure and Fusion Center leadership (5%)
* Conduct security reviews of enterprise business applications, including Salesforce, Sage Intacct, the enterprise workforce management platform, and internally developed applications, covering role and permission models, segregation of duties, data sharing and export controls, API and integration credentials, audit logging, and data retention (5%)
* Establish secure development and application security requirements for custom and client-facing applications, including secure coding standards, dependency and vulnerability scanning, penetration testing cadence, and remediation tracking with internal development and vendor teams (5%)
* Drive onboarding of enterprise applications to centralized identity, including Single Sign-On and automated provisioning, and conduct periodic application-level access reviews and offboarding validation (2%)
* Contribute information security and technical expertise to the standards and longer-term strategy for physical security technologies in use at SIS offices and at client sites monitored by the Fusion Center, including video management and camera platforms, access control and badge systems, and emerging AI-based detection and video analytics capabilities, in partnership with the Director of Technology, Fusion Center leadership, and other system owners (5%)

* Perform security review of new technologies, vendors, and contracts, including third-party risk assessment and review of security exhibits and data protection terms (3%)
* Lead SIS's ISO 27001 certification effort end to end, including scoping and the Statement of Applicability, gap assessment against Annex A controls, hands-on implementation and configuration of the technical controls, internal audit, remediation of findings, and successful completion of the Stage 1 and Stage 2 certification audits (TEMPORARY, FIRST ~8 MONTHS)
* Operate and mature the Information Security Management System on an ongoing basis, maintaining the risk register and risk treatment plans, coordinating management review, tracking corrective actions, and preparing the organization for annual surveillance audits and recertification (5%)
* Serve as the primary respondent for client cyber security surveys, security questionnaires, and third-party risk assessments (for example, CAIQ, SIG, and custom client formats), maintaining a curated answer library and evidence repository, and converting identified gaps and client commitments into tracked remediation items driven to closure with the responsible technical owners (5%)
* Define, measure, and report on SIS's security objectives and key security metrics, delivering visible incremental improvement quarter over quarter and reporting progress to tech

Program Manager
  
  
***Location:***  
Princeton, NJ or Los Angeles, CA (currently hybrid) - 2 days per week in the office. Must be local to one of our offices, others will not be considered.  
  
***Reports To:***  
Director, Program Management
  
  
***Salary Range:***  
$80,000 – $120,000. Exact compensation will vary based on experience  
  
***Other:***  
Vaccination against COVID-19 is a prerequisite for employment at CHDI Management  
  
***About CHDI Foundation, Inc.***  
CHDI Foundation, Inc. is a privately funded nonprofit biomedical research organization exclusively dedicated to collaboratively developing therapeutics that will substantially improve the lives of those affected by Huntington’s disease (HD). Our scientists work closely with a network of more than 700 researchers in academic and industrial laboratories around the world in the pursuit of these novel therapies, providing strategic scientific direction to ensure that our common goals remain in focus. This helps bridge the translational gap that often exists between academic and industrial research pursuits and that adds costly delays to therapy development. In its role as a collaborative enabler, CHDI seeks to bring the right partners together to identify and address critical scientific issues and move drug candidates to clinical evaluation as rapidly as possible. Our activities extend from exploratory biology to the identification and validation of therapeutic targets, and from drug discovery and development to clinical studies and trials. More information about CHDI can be found at www.chdifoundation.org.  
  
***Job Description:***  
We are seeking a highly motivated and organized Program Manager to join the preclinical Program Management Office supporting various preclinical teams. The candidate should have strong experience in the coordination and management of translational and preclinical studies. In addition, the candidate should be very detail-oriented and have significant experience working with Ph.D. level scientists. The position offers significant growth opportunities, exposure to a new model of non-profit orphan disease drug discovery, and an entrepreneurial work environment with high impact.
  
  
***Job Responsibilities:***

* Work with CHDI Science Directors to understand project goals and deliverables in order to enable the execution of legal contracts with collaborators, including fee-for-service companies, academic institutions, pharmaceutical companies and biotechnology companies.
* Work with CHDI’s finance and legal officers to execute contracts in compliance with Foundation policies.
* Work with scientists and the financial officer to evaluate and optimize proposed budgets for new projects.

new_jobs.description:
**Job Function Summary**

Involves gathering, analyzing, and interpreting a wide variety of research data. Designs and conducts research including selecting data samples, developing research instruments, analyzing collected information according to established statistical methods, and developing recommendations based on research findings. Prepares reports, charts, tables, and other visual aids to interpret and communicate data and results.

**Generic Scope**

Entry-level professional with limited prior experience; learns to use professional concepts to resolve problems of limited scope and complexity; works on assignments that are initially routine in nature, requiring limited judgment and decision making. Employees at this level are expected to acquire the skills and knowledge to perform more advanced work following an agreed upon time in position, through defined training and development planning.

**Custom Scope**

Under direct supervision, acquires skills and knowledge of professional concepts in research data analysis. Works on small projects or segments of projects with limited scope and complexity.

**Department Overview**

The Department of Radiology & Biomedical Imaging is one of the largest departments within the School of Medicine, generating more than $40 million in professional fee revenues each year, and submitting grant proposals resulting in $30-40 million of awards each year. More than 90% of the MD faculty in Radiology is based at the Parnassus Campus, including nine of the ten clinical sections and their chiefs, and five of the seven vice chairs. The department has significant clinical and research operations at China Basin, Mission Bay, the VAMC, ZSFG, and Mount Zion. It includes more than 150 academic personnel and approximately 225 staff FTE. In addition, there are more than 90 resident, fellow, and graduate student trainees.

The Research Data Anl 1 position is focused on the collection of clinical data focused on patients treated with PSMA radioligand therapy and peptide receptor radionuclide therapy. A multicenter database is being created to collect data on these patients to understand toxicity, efficacy and see how these drugs are used clinically. The candidate will work under the general supervision and guidance from the supervisor Dr. Thomas Hope. They will also work with Dr. Abuzar Tuchayi Moradi.

**Your work days are brighter here.**

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

**About the Team**

The Finance Transformation Office (FTO) drives the modernization and optimization of Workday’s global finance function. At the heart of this effort is the Finance Process Ownership team: responsible for governing and transforming the end-to-end processes that enable scale, control, and efficiency across the Finance organization. By integrating strategic process design with technology innovation, automation, and continuous improvement, this team ensures Finance operates with simplicity, accuracy, and insight. This empowers Workday to be its own best Customer Zero.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Principal Business Analyst, Source to Pay to enable the optimization, governance, and transformation of Workday’s global Source to Pay value stream. Reporting to the Director, Finance Process Owner Source to Pay, this individual will perform end-to-end design, performance, and evolution of processes spanning supplier onboarding, sourcing, contract management, procurement, purchasing, invoicing, travel & expense management, and payments. You will partner with cross-functional workstream leads to execute on critical milestones, including activities such as process development, business requirements gathering, UAT test script development and coordination, among others. You will drive day-to-day execution and focus on delivering a frictionless, compliant, and scalable experience for employees, suppliers, and Finance. This role blends deep domain expertise with digital transformation, partnering closely with Business, Technology Teams, and Program/Portfolio Management teams to showcase world-class use of Workday Financial Management and related capabilities.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Partner with the Finance Process Owner to define and evolve current-state and future-state process flows across the Source to Pay lifecycle, including supplier lifecycle management, contract lifecycle management, requisitioning, sourcing, purchasing, receiving, invoicing, expense management, and payment execution.
* Support global e-invoicing initiatives and ensure compliance with regional regulatory requirements.
* Independently identify and resolve gaps, dependencies, and conflicting requirements across workstreams.
* Translate complex business, policy, and regulatory requirements into clear, scalable process designs, functional requirements, and Jira stories.
* Own requirements traceability and change management, documenting changes, assessing downstream impacts, and maintaining alignment through design, build, testing, and release.
* Facilitate requirements walkthroughs and sign-off sessions with business and technical stakeholders to confirm scope and reduce rework.
* Ensure requirements account for global process consistency while accommodating local business, tax, statutory, and payment considerations.
* Develop and maintain Source to Pay test scripts, scenarios, expected results, requirements traceability, and testing evidence.
* Execute end-to-end transaction testing across Workday Financials (Spend Management, Accounting Center) and connected systems, validating both business process and downstream accounting outcomes such as invoices, AR/AP balances, journal entries, and GL postings.
* Lead Source to Pay UAT ceremonies, driving testing progress, priorities, blockers, defects, and actions to closure.
* Track execution, requirements coverage, defects, retesting, and business sign-offs through Jira.
* Provide critical testing capacity during quarter-end, Q4 blackout, and year-end periods when Finance SME availability is constrained.
* Champion, test, and pilot new Workday features and AI capabilities across Procurement, Expenses, Supplier Accounts, and Financial Management, providing actionable feedback to Product Management
* Drive team adoption of AI tools to produce more consistent and higher quality outputs across transformation projects.
* Support design, configuration, and adoption of scalable, system-driven Source to Pay processes powered by Workday, including intelligent supplier onboarding, guided buying, automated invoice matching, payment controls, exception management, and real-time analytics.
* Own the development and monitoring of KPIs that measure process health, such as requisition-to-purchase-order cycle time, purchase-order compliance, touchless invoice rate, invoice exception rate, on-time payment performance, early-payment discount capture, and cost per invoice.
* Partner with controllership, internal audit, tax, and compliance teams to drive process integrity, SOX compliance, audit readiness, and appropriate segregation of duties.
